words.tr: phrase. 封面；头版（通常指报纸或杂志的第一页）
words.ex: The news is on the front page of the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻登在报纸的头版。
words.en: The first page of a newspaper or magazine, where the most important news is printed.

words.ex: He eats a nut every morning for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一颗坚果当早餐。
words.en: A nut is a fruit consisting of a hard or tough shell around an edible kernel. It is also a metal block with a threaded hole that is used with a bolt to fasten things together. Informally, it can refer to someone who is crazy or eccentric.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.tr: phrase. 最上层架子；（引申义）最高品质的，一流的
words.ex: He put the wine on the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把酒放在最上层架子上。
words.en: Of the highest quality or excellence.

words.ex: He is a top level manager in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司的一名高级经理。
words.en: Relating to the highest level of an organization or system.

words.tr: phrase. 红色印刷；红字印刷；用红字标出的文字
words.ex: The teacher put red print on my homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师在我的作业上用红笔做了标记。
words.en: Printing in red color, often used to highlight or emphasize certain parts of a text.

words.ex: He bought a mid-range phone for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一部中档手机。
words.en: Mid-range refers to something that is of average or medium quality, size, or price, not being the highest or lowest in its category.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的视野；优美的景观
words.ex: The hotel room has a good view of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个酒店房间有很好的海景。
words.en: An attractive or impressive scene, often of a landscape, seen from a particular position.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊项目；特别事项
words.ex: The store sells special items for collectors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售给收藏家的特殊物品。
words.en: Specific articles or features that are distinct or exceptional within a larger set.

words.ex: He has a small garden behind his house.
words.ex_cn: 他房子后面有一个小花园。
words.en: A small, enclosed area of land, typically adjacent to a house, used for growing plants, flowers, or vegetables.

words.ex: The cat sits on a yellow box.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在一个黄色的箱子里。
words.en: A rectangular container made of cardboard or plastic, painted or coated in yellow, used for storage or packaging.

words.ex: He gave her a bunch of flowers on her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他在她生日时送给她一束花。
words.en: A collection of flowers tied or held together.

words.tr: phrase. 四道菜的晚餐，包含前菜、汤、主菜和甜点等四个部分的正式餐食
words.ex: We had a four-course dinner at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃了一顿四道菜的晚餐。
words.en: A four-course dinner is a meal that consists of four separate parts, usually including an appetizer, soup, main course, and dessert.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.tr: phrase. 手工艺品商店；工艺品店
words.ex: She buys handmade gifts at a craft shop.
words.ex_cn: 她在手工艺品店买手工礼物。
words.en: A craft shop is a store where handmade or artistic items are sold.

words.tr: 名词短语，指刚过中午的时间，通常为下午1点左右
words.ex: He takes a nap in the early afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午早些时候小睡一会儿。
words.en: The period of time in the afternoon that is closer to noon rather than evening.

words.tr: phrase. 商业区；大商场；大型购物中心
words.ex: We went to the shopping mall to buy clothes and eat dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们去商业区买衣服和吃晚饭。
words.en: A shopping mall is a large building or group of buildings containing a variety of stores and often restaurants and other business establishments situated close together.

words.ex: The toys are in small boxes.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在小盒子里。
words.en: Small containers, typically square or rectangular, used for holding items.

words.tr:
n. 味觉；味道；品味；喜好；
v. 品尝；有…味道；
words.ex: My taste can detect sweet and sour flavors.
words.ex_cn: 我的味觉能分辨甜味和酸味。
words.en: The sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth and throat on contact with a substance.

words.ex: The maid cleans the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 女仆每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A maid is a woman who works as a servant in a hotel or in someone's home.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.tr: n. 不抽烟的人；禁止吸烟列车车厢
words.ex: He is a non-smoker and never drinks alcohol.
words.ex_cn: 他是个不吸烟的人，从不喝酒。
words.en: A non-smoker is a person who does not smoke.

words.tr: phrase. 不健康的饮食；有害健康的膳食
words.ex: He eats an unhealthy diet every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃不健康的饮食。
words.en: A pattern of eating that is detrimental to physical health.

words.ex: He wears casual clothes to the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末穿便服去公园。
words.en: Clothes designed for informal occasions, emphasizing comfort and ease of wear.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr:
n. 日常饮食；节食；
v. 节制饮食；
words.ex: His diet includes lots of vegetables and fruits.
words.ex_cn: 他的日常饮食包括大量蔬菜和水果。
words.en: The food and drink usually consumed by a person or group; a special course of food to which one restricts oneself, either to lose weight or for medical reasons.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天中午吃午餐。
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.tr: phrase. 手工艺品展览会；手作市集
words.ex: They sell handmade toys at the craft fair.
words.ex_cn: 他们在手工艺品展上出售手工玩具。
words.en: A craft fair is an event where people sell goods they have made by hand, such as jewelry, pottery, and textiles.

words.ex: He wears gloves to keep his hands warm.
words.ex_cn: 他戴手套来保暖双手。
words.en: Gloves are pieces of clothing which cover your hands and wrists and have individual sections for each finger. You wear gloves to keep your hands warm or dry or to protect them.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: He eats beef for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃牛肉当晚餐。
words.en: Beef is the meat from a cow, bull, or ox. When people beef about something, they complain about it.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: She uses cosmetic cream to make her skin look better.
words.ex_cn: 她使用美容霜让皮肤看起来更好。
words.en: A cosmetic is a substance that you put on your face or body to improve its appearance.

words.ex: He filled out the booking form for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他填写了酒店的预订表格。
words.en: A document used to reserve or book a service, such as a hotel room or flight.

words.ex: He filled out the order form for the books.
words.ex_cn: 他填了书籍的订购单。
words.en: A document used to request goods or services, detailing the items desired, quantities, and other relevant information.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He ate a piece of chocolate after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一块巧克力。
words.en: A food preparation in the form of a paste or solid block made from roasted and ground cacao seeds, typically sweetened.

words.tr: phrase. 巧克力棒；巧克力条
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后吃了一块巧克力棒。
words.en: A chocolate bar is a confectionery product that consists of chocolate in a solid form, often molded into a rectangular shape.

words.tr: phrase. 本地海鲜；当地捕捞或出产的海产食品
words.ex: We ate fresh local seafood at the beach restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩的餐厅吃了新鲜的当地海鲜。
words.en: Local seafood refers to seafood that is caught or harvested in the nearby area, often known for its freshness and connection to the local cuisine.

words.ex: The town lost electricity during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间，这个城镇停电了。
words.en: A form of energy resulting from the existence of charged particles (such as electrons or protons), either statically as an accumulation of charge or dynamically as a current.

words.ex: He paid the electricity bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天交了电费。
words.en: A bill for the amount of electricity used in a particular period, typically sent monthly.

words.tr: phrase. 四处走动；来回移动；到处活动
words.ex: The cat likes to move around the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在晚上在家里四处走动。
words.en: To move around means to travel from one place to another or to change the position of something or someone.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: She added a tomato to her salad.
words.ex_cn: 她往沙拉里加了一个西红柿。
words.en: A tomato is a soft, red fruit that is eaten raw or cooked as a vegetable.

words.tr: phrase. 网上账单；在线账单
words.ex: He pays his online bills every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付在线账单。
words.en: Online bills refer to the electronic versions of bills that are accessible and payable through the internet.

words.ex: He likes online shopping for clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在网上买衣服。
words.en: The activity of buying goods or services over the internet.

words.ex: He uses an online service to pay his bills.
words.ex_cn: 他使用在线服务支付账单。
words.en: An online service is a service that is available on the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.tr:
adj. 灰色的；
n. 灰色；
words.ex: The sky is grey today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是灰色的。
words.en: Of a color intermediate between black and white, as of ashes or lead.

words.tr: phrase. 本地艺术家；当地艺人
words.ex: Local artists paint colorful murals on the walls.
words.ex_cn: 本地艺术家在墙上画彩色壁画。
words.en: Local artists refer to artists who are based in or originate from a particular area or community.

words.tr: phrase. 地方菜肴；本地特色菜
words.ex: We tried local dishes at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我们在市场上尝了当地菜肴。
words.en: Local dishes refer to the traditional or typical foods that are associated with a particular area or region, often made with ingredients that are locally available.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃面包和鸡蛋。
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.tr:
n. 素食者；食草动物；
adj. 素食者的；素菜的；
words.ex: He is a vegetarian and doesn't eat meat.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名素食者，不吃肉。
words.en: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat meat or fish, and sometimes other animal products, especially for moral, religious, or health reasons.

words.ex: They have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚上7点吃晚饭。
words.en: To eat the main meal of the day, typically in the evening.

words.ex: The gym charges an annual fee of $50.
words.ex_cn: 健身房收取50美元的年费。
words.en: A yearly charge for the use of a service or membership.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the lamb every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂羔羊。
words.en: A lamb is a young sheep.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.tr:
n. 折扣；
v. 不全信；不重视；
words.ex: The store gave a 20% discount on all shoes.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有鞋子提供了20%的折扣。
words.en: A reduction in the usual price of something, or the act of reducing the price.

words.tr: phrase. 组成整体；装配；组合
words.ex: He put together a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他做了个三明治当午餐。
words.en: To assemble or compile various parts or elements into a whole.

words.tr: phrase. 零售连锁；连锁零售企业
words.ex: The retail chain opened a new store in the mall.
words.ex_cn: 这家零售连锁店在商场开了一家新店。
words.en: A retail chain is a group of retail stores that are owned and operated by the same company, typically offering similar products and services across different locations.

words.tr: n. 园艺（学）； v. 从事园艺；“garden”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys gardening in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在后院做园艺。
words.en: The activity of tending and cultivating a garden, especially as a pastime.

words.ex: He pays his monthly paper bills with cash.
words.ex_cn: 他用现金支付每月的纸质账单。
words.en: Documents issued monthly that detail charges for utilities, services, or subscriptions, often requiring payment.

words.ex: The store offers low prices on fresh vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店对新鲜蔬菜提供低价。
words.en: Low prices refer to the cost of goods or services being below the average or expected level.

words.ex: He ate popcorn made from corn.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了用玉米做的爆米花。
words.en: Corn is a tall plant which produces long vegetables covered with yellow seeds. It is also a cereal crop.

words.ex: The library gives books free of charge.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆免费提供书籍。
words.en: If something is free of charge, it does not cost anything.

words.ex: The software offers free installation.
words.ex_cn: 该软件提供免费安装。
words.en: The act of setting up software or equipment without charge.

words.ex: He gets a free drink with his meal.
words.ex_cn: 他用餐时得到一杯免费饮料。
words.en: A drink provided at no cost to the consumer.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的家用电器；免费的装置设备
words.ex: The store gives free appliances with every purchase.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每笔购买都赠送免费电器。
words.en: Electrical or mechanical devices provided at no cost, often as part of a promotion, rental agreement, or service package.

words.tr: phrase. 免费送货的；提供免费递送服务的
words.ex: The online store offers free delivery for all orders.
words.ex_cn: 这家在线商店为所有订单提供免费送货。
words.en: The service of delivering goods to a customer's location without additional charge.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅吃晚饭。
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He bought drinks and snacks at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了饮料和小吃。
words.en: Drinks and snacks refer to beverages and light food items that are consumed between meals.

words.tr: 名词短语，指饮料和鲜花，常用于表达送礼或庆祝场合中的物品组合
words.ex: He buys drinks and flowers for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买饮料和鲜花。
words.en: A casual social gathering, often involving alcoholic beverages and casual conversation.

words.ex: He picked his dinner from the salad bar.
words.ex_cn: 他从沙拉吧挑选了他的晚餐。
words.en: A salad bar is a buffet-style table or counter at a restaurant or food service facility where customers can assemble their own salad plates from a variety of ingredients.

words.tr: phrase. 灵活的工作时间；可变动的上班时间
words.ex: He works with flexible hours to balance his family time.
words.ex_cn: 他工作时间灵活，以便平衡家庭时间。
words.en: A work schedule that allows employees to vary their arrival and/or departure times.

words.ex: I ate chicken for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了鸡肉。
words.en: A chicken is a bird that is kept on a farm for its eggs and meat.

words.ex: He drinks apple juice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝苹果汁。
words.en: A drink made from the juice of apples.

words.ex: The store has a wide range of shoes.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的鞋子。
words.en: A wide range refers to a large variety or number of different things.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: The currency in Japan is the yen.
words.ex_cn: 日本的货币是日元。
words.en: The system of money in general use in a particular country.

words.ex: The restaurant added a service charge to the bill.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅在账单上加了一笔服务费。
words.en: A service charge is an amount of money that is added to your bill in a restaurant or hotel, to pay for the service you have received.

words.tr: phrase. 鱼饼（一种用鱼肉和调料制成的油炸或煎制食品）
words.ex: He ate fish cakes for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了鱼饼。
words.en: Fish cakes are a type of food made from fish that has been mixed with other ingredients, shaped into a patty, and then fried or baked.

words.tr: phrase. 驾驶日志；记录驾驶经历或行程的日记
words.ex: He writes his driving diary every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写驾驶日记。
words.en: A driving diary is a record kept by a driver, documenting details of their journeys, such as routes taken, distances covered, and observations about driving conditions or habits.

words.tr: phrase. 驾驶课程；驾驶培训班
words.ex: He is taking a driving class this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周在上驾驶课。
words.en: A course of instruction in driving a vehicle, typically offered by a driving school to prepare students for obtaining a driver's license.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.ex: She wears a gold necklace every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天都戴一条金项链。
words.en: A necklace is a piece of jewellery such as a chain or a string of beads which someone, usually a woman, wears around their neck.

words.tr: phrase. 茶壶；用于泡茶和倒茶的容器
words.ex: She poured tea from the tea pot.
words.ex_cn: 她从茶壶里倒出了茶。
words.en: A teapot is a container with a lid, a handle, and a spout, used for making and serving tea.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: He eats a banana every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A banana is a long curved fruit with a yellow skin and soft, sweet, white flesh inside.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: The receptionist greeted the visitors with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 接待员微笑着迎接了访客。
words.en: A receptionist is a person whose job is to deal with people arriving at or telephoning a hotel, office building, doctor's surgery, etc.

words.ex: The car needs a new starter to start the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车需要一个新的启动器来发动引擎。
words.en: A starter is a person or thing that starts something, especially a device that initiates the operation of an engine or machine.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.ex: He ate a hot meal after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后吃了一顿热饭。
words.en: A hot meal is food that has been cooked and is served warm, providing comfort and nourishment.

words.tr: phrase. 特价商品；特价销售
words.ex: The store has special offers on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在周末有特价优惠。
words.en: Special offers are discounts or deals that are available for a limited time to encourage people to buy a product or service.

words.tr: phrase. 健身房会员资格；指加入健身房并享有使用其设施的权利
words.ex: He bought a gym membership last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周办了一张健身房会员卡。
words.en: A gym membership is a formal agreement which allows you to use the facilities of a gym.

words.tr: phrase. 高能量零食；能快速补充体力的小吃
words.ex: He eats high-energy snacks before running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步前吃高能量零食。
words.en: High-energy snacks refer to food items that provide a significant amount of energy, usually in the form of calories, to help sustain physical activity or to replenish energy stores.

words.ex: He collects bottle tops from soda bottles.
words.ex_cn: 他收集苏打水瓶的瓶盖。
words.en: The cap or lid that seals the opening of a bottle.

words.tr: phrase. 浪费金钱；挥霍钱财
words.ex: He wastes money on useless toys.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱浪费在无用的玩具上。
words.en: To spend money in a way that is not necessary or does not produce any useful result.

words.ex: The family user shares the tablet with everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭用户和每个人共用平板电脑。
words.en: A person who is a member of a household and uses shared resources, services, or devices within a family context.

words.ex: He sent the letter by post.
words.ex_cn: 他通过邮寄寄出了这封信。
words.en: By post means sending something through the postal system.

words.tr: phrase. 粉色与黄色的；由粉色和黄色组成的；呈现粉黄配色的
words.ex: The flowers are pink and yellow.
words.ex_cn: 这些花是粉红色和黄色的。
words.en: A combination of the colors pink and yellow, often used to describe an object, pattern, or design featuring both hues.

words.tr: phrase. 傍晚；黄昏初期，指日落后不久的一段时间
words.ex: We eat dinner in the early evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在傍晚早些时候吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.ex: He drinks beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝啤酒。
words.en: Beer is an alcoholic drink made from grain.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.ex: She wrapped the candy in silver paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用银色纸包了糖果。
words.en: Silver paper refers to a thin, metallic paper that is used for wrapping or decorative purposes, often resembling the appearance of silver.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He eats pork for dinner every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日吃猪肉当晚餐。
words.en: Pork is meat from a pig, usually fresh and not smoked or salted.

words.tr: n. 出口；发泄途径；经销店；折扣店
words.ex: The river flows out through an outlet.
words.ex_cn: 河水通过一个出口流出。
words.en: An outlet is a hole or pipe through which liquid or air can flow out, or a point in a wall where you can connect electrical equipment to the electricity supply.

words.ex: He wears a dark blue shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿一件深蓝色的衬衫。
words.en: A dark blue color is a deep shade of blue.

words.ex: She boiled an egg for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她为早餐煮了一个蛋。
words.en: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.tr: phrase. 买得最合算的商品
words.ex: This store has the best buy for headphones.
words.ex_cn: 这家店的耳机买得最合算。
words.en: The best buy refers to the most advantageous purchase or deal available, offering the highest value for the money spent.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The market sells fresh meat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市场每天早上卖新鲜肉类。
words.en: Fresh meat refers to meat that has not been preserved by smoking, curing, or freezing and is therefore considered to be in its natural state. It can also metaphorically refer to someone who is new to a particular activity or environment.

words.ex: She buys fresh food every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上买新鲜食物。
words.en: Food that has been recently harvested, butchered, or caught and has not been preserved by freezing, canning, or other means.

words.tr:
v. 计算；看作；清点；
n. 计数；计算；
words.ex: He counts the apples on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他计算桌子上的苹果数量。
words.en: To determine the total number of a collection of items.

words.tr: phrase. 数字存储；数字储存（指以数字格式保存数据的技术或设备，如硬盘、U盘、云存储等）
words.ex: He uses digital storage to save his photos.
words.ex_cn: 他使用数字存储来保存他的照片。
words.en: Digital storage refers to the process of storing data in digital format, which can be accessed and retrieved by electronic devices.

words.ex: I ordered a vegetable burger for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐点了一个蔬菜汉堡。
words.en: A vegetable burger is a type of burger that uses vegetables, grains, or legumes as the main ingredients instead of meat.

words.ex: There is an extra charge for late payment.
words.ex_cn: 迟交款项会收取额外费用。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid for a service or product beyond the standard or advertised price.

words.tr:
n. 光泽；上光剂；
v. 擦亮；润色；
words.ex: The polish of the wooden table made it shine.
words.ex_cn: 木桌的光泽让它闪闪发亮。
words.en: If you polish something, you make it smooth and shiny by rubbing it with a cloth or a special substance. Polish is also a substance that you use to make things smooth and shiny.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: He rubbed his chin when he thought.
words.ex_cn: 他思考时摸了摸下巴。
words.en: The part of the face below the mouth and above the neck.

words.tr: phrase. 两人共有的银行账户；联合账户
words.ex: They have a joint account for their rent and groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个共同账户用于支付房租和杂货。
words.en: A joint account is a bank account shared by two or more individuals, typically used for managing shared expenses or assets.

words.ex: The money lender gave him a loan with high interest.
words.ex_cn: 放贷人给了他一笔高利息的贷款。
words.en: A money lender is a person or organization whose business is lending money to people who then pay back the money with interest.

words.ex: We are reading chapter ten in our history book.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在历史课本中阅读第十章。
words.en: The tenth section of a book, report, or other written work, typically containing a distinct topic or part of the narrative.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr: 十幅画（painting 的复数形式，指绘画作品）
words.ex: He sold ten paintings last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月卖了十幅画。
words.en: Ten paintings refers to a collection or group of ten distinct pieces of artwork created using paint.

words.ex: He paid with Mastercard at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店用万事达卡付款。
words.en: A brand of credit card.

words.ex: The thief stole a wallet from the bag.
words.ex_cn: 小偷偷走了包里的钱包。
words.en: A thief is a person who steals something from another person or place.

words.tr: phrase. 不同的比率；不同的速度；不同的费率
words.ex: The cars move at different rates.
words.ex_cn: 这些车以不同的速度行驶。
words.en: Varying costs or fees charged for different services, products, or usage levels, often based on time, quantity, or type.

words.ex: He sat by the middle window and watched the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在中间的窗户旁看着雨。
words.en: A window located in the central part of a building's facade or a room, often serving as a primary source of light and view.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.ex: He packed his clothes into a suitcase.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服装进了行李箱。
words.en: A suitcase is a case with a handle and often with wheels, used for carrying clothes and possessions when travelling.

words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly at night.
words.ex_cn: 深夜里，火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: A device that makes a loud noise to warn people of a fire.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.ex: He signed the written document.
words.ex_cn: 他签了这份书面文件。
words.en: A written document is a piece of written work that provides information or evidence or that serves as an official record.

words.ex: The audience clapped loudly after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众热烈鼓掌。
words.en: The group of spectators at a public event; listeners or viewers collectively, especially those attending a performance or reading a particular work.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: The police found the lost children near the park.
words.ex_cn: 警察在公园附近找到了走失的孩子。
words.en: Children who have become separated from their parents or guardians and are unable to locate them, often requiring assistance.

words.ex: The police caught the man for a serious crime.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓住了那个犯下严重罪行的人。
words.en: A crime is an illegal action or activity for which a person can be punished by law.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.ex: He wears a leather jacket in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿皮夹克。
words.en: A leather jacket is a jacket-length coat that is usually worn on top of other apparel, and which is made from the tanned hide of various animals. The leather material is typically dyed black, or various shades of brown, but a wide range of colors is possible.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: adj. 被偷走的； v. 偷；“steal”的过去分词；
words.ex: The stolen bike was found near the park.
words.ex_cn: 那辆被偷的自行车在公园附近找到了。
words.en: Taken without the owner's consent; obtained by theft.

words.tr: phrase. 在门旁边；靠近门的地方
words.ex: The keys are by the door.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在门边。
words.en: located near the entrance of a room or building

words.ex: He saves money every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存钱。
words.en: To keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy something in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 遗失物品；丢失的物品
words.ex: He found a lost item in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园里找到了一件遗失的物品。
words.en: An item that has been lost and not yet found.

words.ex: He handed out a leaflet about the event.
words.ex_cn: 他分发了一份关于该活动的传单。
words.en: A leaflet is a small sheet of printed paper that gives you information or advertises something.

words.ex: He is self-funded during his PhD.
words.ex_cn: 他在攻读博士学位期间自费。
words.en: Self-funded refers to something that is financed by one's own resources rather than external funding.

words.ex: He left the house through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 他从后门离开了房子。
words.en: A back door is a door at the back of a building, or a way of achieving something secretly or unofficially.

words.ex: The company got a corporate loan to expand its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司获得了一笔企业贷款来扩展业务。
words.en: A corporate loan is a loan made to a business rather than an individual, typically for the purpose of expansion, equipment purchase, or working capital.

words.ex: Follow the safety rules at the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 在建筑工地遵守安全规定。
words.en: Regulations or principles designed to ensure safety and prevent accidents or injuries.

words.ex: The pilot does a safety check before takeoff.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员在起飞前进行安全检查。
words.en: An inspection or examination to ensure that something is safe or in proper condition.

words.ex: He took passport photos at the photo shop.
words.ex_cn: 他在照相馆拍了护照照片。
words.en: Photographs that are required for official documents such as passports, meeting specific size and quality criteria.

words.tr: 短语动词. 打电话报警；叫警察
words.ex: If you see a crime, call the police.
words.ex_cn: 如果你看到犯罪，就报警。
words.en: To contact the police in order to report a crime or emergency.

words.tr: phrase. 报警系统；警报装置
words.ex: The house has an alarm system to keep it safe.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个报警系统来保障安全。
words.en: An alarm system is a system designed to detect intrusion – unauthorized entry – into a building or other areas such as a home or school.

words.tr: phrase. 更高效的；更有效的
words.ex: This machine is more efficient than the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器比旧的更高效。
words.en: Achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or expense.

words.ex: He has two pockets in his jacket.
words.ex_cn: 他的夹克上有两个口袋。
words.en: Two compartments or pouches sewn into or onto a garment for carrying small items.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: The bank raised the interest rate last month.
words.ex_cn: 银行上个月提高了利率。
words.en: The interest rate is the percentage of an amount of money which is paid for its use for a specified time, usually expressed as an annual percentage rate.

words.tr: phrase. 私密内容；私人信息
words.ex: He deleted the private content from his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他删除了手机里的私密内容。
words.en: Material, such as text or images, that is not publicly accessible and is intended for a limited audience.

words.tr: phrase. 每三个月一次，季度性地
words.ex: He visits his grandparents every three months.
words.ex_cn: 他每三个月去看望一次祖父母。
words.en: Happening once in each three-month period.

words.tr: phrase. 低风险的投资；指波动小、本金损失概率低的投资产品
words.ex: He put his money in low-risk investments.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱投资于低风险的投资。
words.en: Investments that are considered to have a lower risk of losing money, typically offering lower returns than higher-risk investments.

words.ex: He showed his identity card at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证。
words.en: An identity card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it that proves who they are.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证号码；识别号码
words.ex: He gave his id number to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的身份证号给了老师。
words.en: a unique identifier assigned to a person or entity

words.tr: n. 一件物品或商品；项目；一则；
words.ex: This item is on sale for $5.
words.ex_cn: 这件商品正在促销，售价5美元。
words.en: An item is one of a collection or list of objects.

words.tr: phrase. 现今；当代；目前的日子
words.ex: In present days, many people use smartphones every day.
words.ex_cn: 在当今时代，许多人每天使用智能手机。
words.en: The current time or era, referring to the period in which we are living now.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: He used the cash machine to get money.
words.ex_cn: 他使用取款机取钱。
words.en: A cash machine is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 货物的损失；物品遗失
words.ex: The truck had a loss of goods during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 卡车在风暴中损失了货物。
words.en: the disappearance or damage of merchandise or items

words.tr: phrase. 金融市场；进行金融资产（如股票、债券等）交易的市场
words.ex: The financial market went down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天金融市场下跌了。
words.en: A financial market is a market in which people trade financial securities, commodities, and other fungible items of value at low transaction costs and at prices that reflect supply and demand.

words.ex: He uses his student account to get free software.
words.ex_cn: 他使用学生账户来获取免费软件。
words.en: A bank account specifically designed for students, often offering benefits such as lower fees or special interest rates.

words.ex: She pulled the curtain to block the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 她拉上帷幕以挡住阳光。
words.en: A curtain is a piece of material that hangs down, often used to cover a window or to divide a room.

words.tr: n. 夫或妻的兄弟；姐夫；妹夫；连襟；姻兄弟
words.ex: My brother-in-law works at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 我的姐夫/妹夫在医院工作。
words.en: The brother of your husband or wife, or the man who is married to your sister.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: He takes risks to start his own business.
words.ex_cn: 他冒险创业。
words.en: To undertake actions or decisions that involve the possibility of loss or failure.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: He paid the first installment last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周支付了第一期分期付款。
words.en: An installment is one of the amounts, usually equal, into which a debt is divided for payment at stated intervals over a fixed period.

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.ex: He bought an insurance policy for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了一份保险单。
words.en: A contract between an individual or entity and an insurance company, whereby the insurer agrees to provide specified protection against possible future losses in exchange for premiums paid by the insured.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: He double-locked the door before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前给门上了双重锁。
words.en: To lock something with two locks or mechanisms to ensure extra security.

words.ex: He paid off his debt last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月还清了债务。
words.en: A debt is a sum of money that you owe someone.

words.tr: phrase. 借记卡；签帐卡；提款卡
words.ex: I use my debit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的借记卡买食物。
words.en: A debit card is a plastic card which can be used to pay for things directly from your bank account when you are shopping, or to withdraw money from a cash machine.

words.ex: He used a traveller's cheque to pay for his hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他用旅行支票支付了酒店费用。
words.en: A traveller's cheque is a cheque for a fixed amount that can be used as a safe way of carrying money when you are travelling.

words.tr: phrase. 烟雾报警器；烟感警报装置
words.ex: The smoke alarm went off at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜里的烟雾报警器响了。
words.en: A smoke alarm is a device that makes a loud noise to warn people when it detects smoke, indicating a possible fire.

words.tr: v. 淹没；“flood”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The rain flooded the streets.
words.ex_cn: 雨水淹没了街道。
words.en: Covered or overflowing with water; filled to overflowing.

words.ex: The paper was torn in half.
words.ex_cn: 这张纸被撕成了两半。
words.en: If you are torn between two or more things, you cannot decide which to choose, and so you feel anxious or troubled.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.tr: phrase. 银行贷款；由银行提供的借款
words.ex: He got a bank loan to buy a car.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔银行贷款来买一辆车。
words.en: A bank loan is a sum of money lent by a bank to a customer at an agreed rate of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 第三方保险；指为被保险人对第三方所负法律责任提供保障的保险
words.ex: He bought third-party insurance for his car.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的车买了第三方保险。
words.en: Insurance that covers the policyholder against claims from third parties for injury or damage caused by the policyholder.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.

words.ex: She put the food on a clean plate.
words.ex_cn: 她把食物放在一个干净的盘子里。
words.en: A flat dish, typically circular and made of china, from which food is eaten or served.

words.ex: He forgot his password and could not log in.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记了密码，无法登录。
words.en: A password is a secret word or phrase that you must know in order to be allowed to enter a place or to use a computer system.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.tr: phrase. 维修费用；修理成本
words.ex: The repair cost was too high for me.
words.ex_cn: 修理费用对我来说太高了。
words.en: The amount of money required to fix or restore something to a good condition.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.tr: phrase. 提供支持；给予帮助；给予支援
words.ex: The teacher provides support to students who struggle.
words.ex_cn: 老师为有困难的学生提供支持。
words.en: to give assistance, help, or backing to someone or something

words.tr: n. 储蓄金；存款；“saving”的复数；
words.ex: He used his savings to buy a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的储蓄买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Money that someone has saved, especially in a bank or official scheme.

words.ex: You need to pay a 40-yuan deposit to rent the bike.
words.ex_cn: 租自行车需要支付40元押金。
words.en: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it. It is also a sum of money that you pay into a bank account.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.ex: The startup wants to raise capital from investors.
words.ex_cn: 这家初创公司想从投资者那里筹集资金。
words.en: To raise capital means to obtain money from investors or lenders to finance a business, project, or investment.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了腿。
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.tr: phrase. 文化意识；对不同文化的价值观、信仰、习俗和行为方式的理解和认识
words.ex: He shows cultural awareness when he respects different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 当他尊重不同的传统时，他展现了文化意识。
words.en: Cultural awareness refers to the understanding and sensitivity towards the differences and similarities between cultures.

words.ex: He works in the accounts department.
words.ex_cn: 他在财务部门工作。
words.en: The department within a company that is responsible for preparing and maintaining the financial records.

words.tr: phrase. 从星期二到星期六（表示时间范围）
words.ex: The store is open from Tuesdays to Saturdays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店从星期二到星期六营业。
words.en: from Tuesday through Saturday, inclusive

words.ex: We eat pancakes on Saturday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六早上吃煎饼。
words.en: The period of time from sunrise to noon on the day of the week following Friday and preceding Sunday.

words.ex: The first Tuesday is always busy for me.
words.ex_cn: 第一个星期二我总是很忙。
words.en: the initial Tuesday of a specific period or sequence

words.tr: phrase. 高温状态；炎热的条件
words.ex: He is working in a hot condition.
words.ex_cn: 他正在高温环境下工作。
words.en: a state of high temperature or heat

words.tr: phrase. 非正常社交时间；指在大多数人休息或社交活动之外的工作时段（如深夜、清晨或周末）
words.ex: He works unsocial hours every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都上夜班。
words.en: Unsocial hours refer to hours outside the standard working day, such as nights, weekends, or holidays, when most people are not working and are engaging in social or leisure activities.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.ex: We celebrate New Year's Day with family.
words.ex_cn: 我们和家人一起庆祝新年。
words.en: New Year's Day is the first day of the year, celebrated as a public holiday in many countries.

words.tr: phrase. 一个更大的办公室
words.ex: He wants a larger office.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一个更大的办公室。
words.en: a room or workspace that is greater in size than another

words.tr: phrase. 从七月到八月；七月至八月之间
words.ex: The school is closed from July to August.
words.ex_cn: 学校从七月到八月关闭。
words.en: the period spanning the months of July and August

words.tr: phrase. 工作表现；工作绩效
words.ex: His work performance improved last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月的工作表现提高了。
words.en: The manner in which a job is executed or the level of achievement in a job role.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: phrase. 就业机会；工作机会
words.ex: He found many job opportunities in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城里找到了很多工作机会。
words.en: The possibility of finding employment or a position in a particular field or area.

words.tr: adj. 勤勉的；努力工作的
words.ex: He is hard-working and always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他很勤奋，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is hard-working always puts a lot of effort and care into their work.

words.tr: phrase. 工作类型；职业种类
words.ex: He wants to know types of jobs in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他想了解这座城市里的各种工作类型。
words.en: Different categories or kinds of employment or work.

words.tr: phrase. 求职面试；工作面试；招聘面谈
words.ex: He will have a job interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将参加一场工作面试。
words.en: A job interview is a formal meeting in which an applicant is asked questions to determine their suitability for a particular job.

words.ex: He receives his wages every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: Wages are the money that someone is paid each week by their employer, especially for work that is done manually or in a factory.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.ex_cn: 雨下了一整夜。
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: He improved his communication skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中提高了沟通技能。
words.en: Communication skills refer to the ability to convey information to another effectively and efficiently.

words.ex: The waitress brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 女服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waitress is a woman who works in a restaurant, serving food and drink to customers.

words.tr: phrase. 不规律的工作时间；非固定工时
words.ex: He works irregular hours at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院工作时间不固定。
words.en: Irregular hours refer to work hours that do not follow a standard or predictable schedule, often varying from day to day or week to week.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.ex: He works as a programmer because it offers good pay.
words.ex_cn: 他做程序员，因为这份工作报酬优厚。
words.en: Good pay refers to a salary or wage that is considered high or above average, often used to describe jobs or positions that offer financial compensation significantly higher than the norm.

words.tr: phrase. +adj. 相对较高的；相对更高的
words.ex: The price is relatively higher than last year.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格比去年相对更高。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is higher compared to something else, but not necessarily high in an absolute sense.

words.tr: 短语动词. 逃离工作；摆脱工作压力
words.ex: He tries to escape from work by walking in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他通过在公园散步来逃避工作。
words.en: To avoid or get away from the duties or responsibilities of one's job or employment.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.tr: phrase. 未来的薪水；将来获得的工资
words.ex: He wants to know his future salary before accepting the job.
words.ex_cn: 他在接受这份工作之前想了解未来的薪水。
words.en: A salary that will be earned in the future, often discussed in job negotiations or financial planning.

words.ex: He is planning his future career as a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他正在规划自己未来当医生的职业。
words.en: A future career refers to the profession or occupation that a person plans to engage in at a later time.

words.ex: He telephoned the employer to ask about the job.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给雇主询问工作的事。
words.en: To contact an employer by phone, typically to discuss a job application or interview.

words.tr: n. 清洁；打扫； v. 打扫；“clean”的现在分词；
words.ex: The cleaning of the room took an hour.
words.ex_cn: 打扫房间花了一个小时。
words.en: The act of making something clean, especially the inside of a house or building.

words.ex: We eat lunch at midday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃午饭。
words.en: Midday is the middle part of the day, from noon until early afternoon.

words.tr: phrase. 正式服装；礼服，指在正式场合穿着的庄重服饰
words.ex: He wears formal clothes to the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他穿正装去参加婚礼。
words.en: Clothing that is suitable for formal occasions, such as suits for men and evening dresses for women.

words.tr:
adj. 可变的；易变的；
n. 变量；
words.ex: The weather is variable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: A variable is something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation.

words.tr: phrase. 橱窗装饰；橱窗布置；弄虚作假
words.ex: The store put flowers and lights as window dressing for the holiday sale.
words.ex_cn: 商店为了节日促销，用鲜花和灯光做橱窗装饰。
words.en: The act of making something appear better than it really is, especially in order to deceive people.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.tr: phrase. 平底鞋；无跟的鞋子
words.ex: She wears flat shoes to walk comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 她穿平底鞋以便走路舒适。
words.en: Shoes that have a very low heel or no heel, making them flat to the ground.

words.ex: The applicant filled out the form carefully.
words.ex_cn: 这位申请人仔细填写了表格。
words.en: An applicant is someone who applies for something, especially a job.

words.ex: He is a candidate for the mayor position.
words.ex_cn: 他是市长职位的候选人。
words.en: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

words.tr: phrase. 白班；日班（指在白天工作的轮班）
words.ex: He works the day shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上白班。
words.en: A day shift refers to a period of time during the day, typically from early morning to late afternoon, when a person is scheduled to work.

words.tr: phrase. 人际交往能力；人际沟通技巧
words.ex: He has good interpersonal skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的人际交往能力。
words.en: The ability to communicate or interact well with other people.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.ex: The reporter asked the president a difficult question.
words.ex_cn: 记者问了总统一个困难的问题。
words.en: A reporter is a person whose job is to discover information about news events and describe them for a newspaper, magazine, radio, or television.

words.ex: He does bookkeeping for his small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的小商店做记账。
words.en: Bookkeeping is the job or activity of keeping an accurate record of the money that is spent and received by a business or other organization.

words.tr:
n. 出纳员，收银员
v. 革除（军职）
words.ex: The cashier counted the money at the end of the day.
words.ex_cn: 收银员在一天结束时清点了钱。
words.en: A cashier is a person whose job is to receive and pay out money in a shop, bank, or business.

words.tr: 名词短语，吉他课程；指学习如何演奏吉他的教学课程
words.ex: He takes guitar lessons every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周六上吉他课。
words.en: Instructional sessions for learning to play the guitar, offered by teachers or music schools.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.ex: Team leaders meet every Monday to plan the week.
words.ex_cn: 团队领导每周一开会规划一周的工作。
words.en: A team leader is a person who provides guidance, instruction, direction and leadership to a group of individuals for the purpose of achieving a key result or group of aligned results.

words.ex: He rides his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去学校。
words.en: A bike is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet. You steer it by turning a bar that is connected to the front wheel.

words.tr: phrase. 自雇工作者；自由职业者
words.ex: Self-employed workers do not work for a company.
words.ex_cn: 自由职业者不为公司工作。
words.en: Individuals who work for themselves rather than for an employer, such as freelancers or business owners.

words.tr: adj. 全部时间的；专任的
words.ex: He works full-time at a grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家杂货店全职工作。
words.en: If you are a full-time worker, you work the normal number of hours or days in a week.

words.tr: phrase. 运输成本；交通费用
words.ex: The cost of transport is high in this city.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的运输费用很高。
words.en: The amount of money required to move goods or people from one place to another.

words.tr: phrase. 农场劳动；农业工作
words.ex: He does farm work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上干农活。
words.en: Work done on a farm, such as planting, harvesting, and caring for animals.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr: phrase. 员工优势；职员所享有的有利条件或福利
words.ex: The staff advantages include free lunch and health insurance.
words.ex_cn: 员工福利包括免费午餐和医疗保险。
words.en: Benefits or perks offered to employees by their employer, such as health insurance or bonuses.

words.tr: phrase. 员工培训；职员训练
words.ex: The school is doing staff training this week.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校本周正在进行员工培训。
words.en: Staff training refers to the process of teaching the skills and knowledge that employees need to perform their jobs effectively.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents once a month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月去看望一次祖父母。
words.en: Used to describe an event that occurs every month.

words.ex: He goes to the gym twice a week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周去两次健身房。
words.en: Two times every week.

words.ex: They live nearby the school.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在学校附近。
words.en: To reside in close proximity to a workplace, which can be a practical consideration for employment.

words.ex: The school gives a free meal to every student.
words.ex_cn: 学校给每个学生提供一顿免费餐。
words.en: A meal provided at no cost to the recipient.

words.tr: phrase. 免费的交通；免费运输
words.ex: The hotel offers free transport to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 酒店提供免费的交通服务去机场。
words.en: Transportation provided at no cost, often as an employee benefit or public service.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的视力；清晰的视觉
words.ex: He has good vision and doesn't need glasses.
words.ex_cn: 他有良好的视力，不需要戴眼镜。
words.en: The ability to see clearly and without visual impairment, sometimes a requirement for certain jobs.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.ex: He does shift work at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂上夜班。
words.en: Work that is done in shifts, especially in a factory or hospital, where different groups of workers work at different times of the day and night.

words.ex: Many people travel during national holidays.
words.ex_cn: 很多人在国庆假期旅行。
words.en: National holidays are public holidays that are recognized and celebrated across a country, often marking significant historical, cultural, or religious events.

words.ex: I will go to London next year.
words.ex_cn: 我明年去伦敦。
words.en: The year following the current one.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: The waiter brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A waiter is a man who works in a restaurant, serving people with food and drink.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: We went for a walk on the weekend evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末的晚上去散步了。
words.en: The period of time between the end of the workweek and the start of the next, typically from Friday evening to Sunday night, especially the evening part of this period.

words.ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: A night shift is a period of work that occurs during the night, typically from late evening to early morning, in various industries and services.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的注意力；高度集中的精神
words.ex: He has good concentration when he reads books.
words.ex_cn: 他读书时注意力很集中。
words.en: The capacity to maintain focus and mental clarity over a period of time, essential for many tasks.

words.ex: He got his truck licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾驶卡车的执照。
words.en: An official document that permits an individual to operate a truck professionally.

words.ex: He got his driving licence last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月拿到了驾照。
words.en: A driving licence is an official document permitting a specific individual to operate one or more types of motorized vehicles on public roads.

words.tr: phrase. 帮助顾客；为客户提供协助
words.ex: She is helping customers at the store.
words.ex_cn: 她正在商店里帮助顾客。
words.en: Providing assistance or support to customers.

words.ex: He practiced common interview questions before the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前练习了常见的面试问题。
words.en: Questions asked during an interview to assess a candidate's suitability for a position.

words.ex: He practiced interview skills before the job interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前练习了面试技巧。
words.en: The abilities and techniques that enable someone to perform well in job interviews, including communication, presentation, and the ability to answer questions effectively.

words.tr: n. 伤残；失去能力；无能力；
words.ex: He has a disability that makes walking difficult.
words.ex_cn: 他有伤残，导致行走困难。
words.en: A disability is a physical or mental condition that limits a person's movements, senses, or activities.

words.ex: He thinks quickly when solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时思维敏捷。
words.en: To think quickly is to process information or make decisions rapidly.

words.tr: n. 钢琴家；钢琴弹奏者；
words.ex: The pianist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位钢琴家在音乐会上演奏了一首美妙的曲子。
words.en: A pianist is a person who plays the piano, especially professionally.

words.ex: The lawyer helps people with legal problems.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助人们解决法律问题。
words.en: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

words.tr:
v. 逃避；逃走；
n. 逃脱；逃避；
words.ex: He tried to escape from the prison.
words.ex_cn: 他试图逃离监狱。
words.en: To escape means to get away from a place or a situation that you are in, especially because it is difficult or dangerous to stay there.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: He spends time watering plants every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上花时间浇灌植物。
words.en: The act of supplying water to plants to promote growth and health.

words.ex: His starting salary is $30,000 per year.
words.ex_cn: 他的起薪是每年3万美元。
words.en: The initial amount of money that an employee is paid when they start a new job.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: He is a consultant for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他是这家大公司的顾问。
words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: He wears a name badge at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中佩戴姓名牌。
words.en: A name badge is a small card or label that you wear, which shows your name and sometimes your job title or the organization you belong to.

words.ex: The senior manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 高级经理批准了这个新项目。
words.en: A senior manager is a person who is in charge of a department or a part of a company, and who is responsible for making decisions and managing staff.

words.ex: She is preparing food for her family.
words.ex_cn: 她正在为家人准备食物。
words.en: The act of making food ready for eating or cooking.

words.ex: He took sick pay when he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧时请了病假工资。
words.en: Sick pay is money paid by an employer to an employee who is unable to work because of illness.

words.tr: phrase. 高级职员；资深员工
words.ex: The senior staff attends weekly meetings.
words.ex_cn: 高级员工参加每周会议。
words.en: Senior staff refers to employees who hold higher positions within an organization, often having more experience, responsibility, and authority than their junior counterparts.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.ex: She does housekeeping every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六做家务。
words.en: Housekeeping refers to the management of duties and chores involved in the running of a household, such as cleaning, cooking, home maintenance, shopping, and bill payment.

words.tr: phrase. 家务劳动；家庭内部的工作，如清洁、烹饪、照顾孩子等
words.ex: She does domestic work every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天做家务。
words.en: Domestic work refers to tasks such as cleaning, cooking, and taking care of children, which are done in a home.

words.ex: The hairdresser cut my hair nicely.
words.ex_cn: 理发师给我剪了一头漂亮的头发。
words.en: A hairdresser is a person who cuts, colours, and arranges people's hair, especially women's, as their job.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a reference letter.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师给他写一封推荐信。
words.en: A reference letter is a document in which the writer assesses the qualities, characteristics, and capabilities of the person being recommended in terms of that individual's ability to perform a particular task or function.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 训练课程；培训时段
words.ex: The team had a training session at 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 团队在早上六点进行了一次训练。
words.en: A training session is a period of time during which people are taught how to do something or how to improve their skills in a particular activity.

words.ex: He is answering the phone right now.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接电话。
words.en: The action of responding to an incoming telephone call.

words.tr: phrase. 职业前景；事业发展潜力
words.ex: He wants to improve his career prospect by learning new skills.
words.ex_cn: 他想通过学习新技能来改善职业前景。
words.en: The possibility or likelihood of future success in a career.

words.tr: phrase. 职业课程；职业技能培训课程
words.ex: He is taking a vocational course in car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他正在参加一门汽车维修的职业课程。
words.en: A vocational course is a type of education that focuses on providing practical skills and knowledge for a specific job or career.

words.ex: He climbed the ladder to fix the roof.
words.ex_cn: 他爬梯子去修屋顶。
words.en: A ladder is a piece of equipment consisting of a series of steps or rungs fixed between two upright lengths of wood, metal, or rope, used for climbing up or down something.

words.ex: He works the evening shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: The period of time during which a person works in the evening, typically from late afternoon to night.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: The school has a strict dress code.
words.ex_cn: 学校有严格的着装规定。
words.en: A set of rules specifying the attire that is appropriate for a particular place or event.

words.tr: n. 清洁工人；清洁工具； adj. 更洁净的；更干净的；“clean”的比较级；
words.ex: The cleaner sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 清洁工人每天早上扫地。
words.en: A cleaner is a person whose job is to clean a place or a substance used for cleaning.

words.ex: He wears dark trousers to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿深色长裤去上班。
words.en: Trousers that are black or very dark in colour, often worn for formal occasions.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: She wears a black skirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 她穿一条黑色裙子去上学。
words.en: A garment for the lower body, typically knee-length or longer, made of fabric and worn as part of a woman's or girl's outfit.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: He is lifting heavy items at the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 他在仓库里搬运重物。
words.en: The physical ability to lift and carry heavy objects, often a requirement for manual or warehouse jobs.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: The company plans to recruit new staff next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划下个月招聘新员工。
words.en: To recruit means to enlist someone in the armed forces or to persuade someone to join a company, organization, or group.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.tr: phrase. 手臂带；袖章；用于手臂上的带状物，常用于标识身份或支持某种活动
words.ex: He wore an arm band to show his support.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一个手臂带以表示他的支持。
words.en: An arm band is a band worn around the arm, typically as a symbol of support, mourning, or membership in a group.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警方昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.tr: phrase. 每隔一周；每两个星期一次
words.ex: He visits his grandparents every second week.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周去看望一次祖父母。
words.en: Occurring every two weeks.

words.ex: He bought a phone card to call his mom.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电话卡给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A phone card is a card that you can use to pay for telephone calls, especially from a public telephone.

words.ex: There are many empty seats in the theater.
words.ex_cn: 剧院里有许多空座位。
words.en: A seat is a place where you can sit, especially a chair or other piece of furniture designed for sitting on, or the part of a chair or other object on which you sit.

words.ex: The director of the school gave a speech.
words.ex_cn: 学校的主任发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A director is a person who is in charge of something, especially a film, play, or organization.

words.ex: He pays rent each month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付房租。
words.en: Every month; once a month.

words.tr: phrase. 每隔一天；每两天一次
words.ex: He goes to the gym every second day.
words.ex_cn: 他每隔一天去一次健身房。
words.en: Happening or done every alternate day.

words.ex: He emptied the dust bag of the vacuum cleaner.
words.ex_cn: 他清空了吸尘器的集尘袋。
words.en: A dust bag is a bag that collects dust and dirt in a vacuum cleaner or a protective cover that prevents dust from settling on an object.

words.tr: phrase. 星期三下午（复数形式，指多个星期三的下午）
words.ex: We play soccer on Wednesday afternoons.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期三下午踢足球。
words.en: Wednesday afternoons refer to the time period of afternoons on Wednesdays, typically used to indicate a specific time for events, activities, or routines that occur regularly on this day of the week.

words.tr: phrase. 星期天的下午（复数形式，指多个周日的下午）
words.ex: We walk in the park on Sunday afternoons.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日下午去公园散步。
words.en: The time period of the afternoon on Sundays.

words.tr: phrase. 星期日的早晨（复数）
words.ex: We eat pancakes on sunday mornings.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期天早上吃煎饼。
words.en: The period of time on Sunday mornings, typically considered a time for relaxation and leisure activities.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr: phrase. 维护费用；保养成本；维修开支
words.ex: The maintenance cost of the car is high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的维护费用很高。
words.en: The expense associated with keeping something in good condition or in working order.

words.ex: The repair fee was twenty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 维修费是二十美元。
words.en: A charge for fixing something that is broken or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 许可证；
v. 允许；准许；
words.ex: He showed his fishing permit to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 他向官员出示了他的钓鱼许可证。
words.en: If someone permits something, they allow it to happen. If they permit you to do something, they allow you to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 自身的能量；个人能量；内在动力
words.ex: He uses his own energy to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他用自己的能量完成比赛。
words.en: Personal motivation or enthusiasm independent of external factors.

words.tr: n. （显示器或电视机图像的）像素
words.ex: The screen has many small pixels.
words.ex_cn: 屏幕上有很多小像素。
words.en: A pixel is the smallest unit of a digital image or graphic that can be displayed and represented on a digital display device.

words.tr: phrase. 入会费；加入时需缴纳的费用
words.ex: You must pay a joining fee to use the gym.
words.ex_cn: 你要支付一笔入会费才能使用健身房。
words.en: A joining fee is a sum of money that you pay when you become a member of a club or organization.

words.ex: He visited his grandma last September.
words.ex_cn: 他去年九月去看了他的奶奶。
words.en: Last September refers to the month of September in the previous year.

words.tr: phrase. 鸡蛋盒；蛋托（用于盛放鸡蛋的纸质或塑料容器）
words.ex: He put the eggs back into the egg cartons.
words.ex_cn: 他把鸡蛋放回了蛋盒里。
words.en: A box or container designed to hold and protect eggs, typically made of cardboard or plastic.

words.tr: phrase. 图书介绍；读书分享会；关于书籍的讨论
words.ex: The students had a book talk about their favorite story.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就他们最喜欢的故事进行了一次读书交流。
words.en: A discussion or event focused on books, often involving authors or readers.

words.ex: He visits his grandma every six weeks.
words.ex_cn: 他每六周去看望一次奶奶。
words.en: Indicates that something occurs once every six weeks.

words.tr: n. 厕所；洗手间；休息室；更衣室
words.ex: He went to the restroom after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后去了洗手间。
words.en: A restroom is a room in a public building with toilets and sinks for people to use.

words.ex: He bought a set of dictionaries for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一套词典。
words.en: A collection of reference books used for looking up words, phrases, or information.

words.ex: The children played with colorful balloons at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上玩彩色气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.tr: phrase. 年轻成年人（通常指18至35岁之间的人群）
words.ex: Young adults often move out to live alone.
words.ex_cn: 年轻人常常搬出去独自生活。
words.en: Young adults are individuals in the age group that is considered to be the transition period from adolescence to full adulthood, typically ranging from 18 to 25 years old.

words.tr: phrase. 在校青少年；指正在上学的十几岁青少年群体
words.ex: School teenagers often spend hours on their homework.
words.ex_cn: 在校青少年常常花数小时做作业。
words.en: Students in secondary education, typically aged 13 to 19.

words.ex: Young teenagers often like to play video games after school.
words.ex_cn: 年轻青少年放学后常常喜欢玩电子游戏。
words.en: Young teenagers refers to individuals in the early stages of their teenage years, typically between the ages of 13 and 15.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.ex: We had coffee together in midmorning.
words.ex_cn: 我们在早晨一起喝了咖啡。
words.en: The middle part of the morning, typically between late morning and noon.

words.ex: Young children love to play with colorful toys.
words.ex_cn: 小孩子喜欢玩色彩鲜艳的玩具。
words.en: Young children refer to children who are in the early stages of their life, typically between the ages of one and eight years.

words.ex: He listens to a radio programme every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听一个广播节目。
words.en: A radio programme is a broadcast that is made for people to listen to on the radio. It can be a series of shows or a single show, covering various topics such as news, music, or talk.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术节；美术节；艺术庆典
words.ex: The town holds an art festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天举办艺术节。
words.en: An event or celebration that showcases various forms of art, such as paintings, sculptures, performances, etc., often held in a specific location for a period of time.

words.ex: He is taking an art course this semester.
words.ex_cn: 他这学期正在上一门艺术课。
words.en: A structured program of study focused on visual or performing arts.

words.tr: phrase. 年龄混合的；不同年龄段混合的
words.ex: The class has mixed ages.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有不同年龄的学生。
words.en: A group of people from different age ranges.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
