words.ex: He feels worse in a cold condition.
words.ex_cn: 他在寒冷的环境中感觉更糟。
words.en: A state or situation characterized by low temperatures.

words.ex: She uses reusable bags instead of plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 她使用可重复使用的袋子，而不是塑料袋。
words.en: Plastic bags are lightweight, flexible containers made of thin plastic, used to carry goods such as groceries.

words.ex: He burns coal to keep his house warm.
words.ex_cn: 他烧煤来让房子暖和。
words.en: Coal is a hard black substance that is extracted from the ground and burned as fuel.

words.ex: Acid rain kills trees and fish.
words.ex_cn: 酸雨杀死树木和鱼类。
words.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes environmental harm, typically to forests and lakes. The main cause is the industrial burning of coal and other fossil fuels, the waste gases from which contain sulfur and nitrogen oxides which combine with atmospheric water to form acids.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.tr:
n. 痕迹；轨迹；微量；
v. 追踪；追溯；仔细查找；
words.ex: There was no trace of blood on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 地板上没有血迹。
words.en: If you trace something such as a pattern or a shape, you draw it carefully over a piece of thin paper. You can also trace someone or something that is missing or has disappeared, by following their movements or actions.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.ex: The soil is moist after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后土壤是潮湿的。
words.en: Slightly wet; damp or humid.

words.tr: phrase. 汽车型号；汽车款式
words.ex: He bought a new car model last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月买了一款新的汽车型号。
words.en: A car model refers to a specific version or design of a car, often distinguished by unique features, specifications, and styling.

words.tr: phrase. 清晰的视野；明确的愿景
words.ex: He has a clear vision for his future.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的未来有清晰的规划。
words.en: A clear vision is a well-defined and unambiguous idea or plan for the future, often used in business or personal development contexts.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.tr: phrase. 内部网站；仅限内部人员访问的网站
words.ex: The company uses an internal website for employee messages.
words.ex_cn: 公司使用内部网站来发送员工信息。
words.en: An internal website is a website that is accessible only to the members of a particular organization, used for sharing information, resources, and tools among employees.

words.tr: phrase. 被关闭的；停止运营的
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂下个月将被关闭。
words.en: To cease operation, especially of a business, machine, or system, often permanently or for a prolonged period.

words.tr: phrase. 二十出头的年龄阶段，通常指20到24岁之间
words.ex: He moved to New York in his early twenties.
words.ex_cn: 他在二十岁出头时搬到了纽约。
words.en: The period of time in a person's life when they are between the ages of 20 and 24.

words.tr: phrase. 大型跨国公司；大型全球性企业
words.ex: Large global companies sell products in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 大型跨国公司在许多国家销售产品。
words.en: Multinational corporations that operate in multiple countries and have a significant worldwide market presence.

words.tr: phrase. 个人原因；私人理由
words.ex: He quit his job for personal reasons.
words.ex_cn: 他因为个人原因辞去了工作。
words.en: Personal reasons refer to matters that affect an individual's private life and are not related to their professional or public life.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.tr: n. 广告活动；广告业； v. 做广告；“advertise”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: The activity of producing advertisements for commercial products or services.

words.tr: n. 支持； v. 支持；“back”的现在分词；
words.ex: His backing helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的支持帮助球队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Support or help.

words.ex: The soup gets hot at high temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 在高温下，汤会变热。
words.en: High temperatures refer to conditions where the temperature is significantly above the average or comfortable range, often leading to various environmental and health issues.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.tr: phrase. 公共部门；公营部门；政府资助的企业；国有企业
words.ex: He works in the public sector as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名教师在公共部门工作。
words.en: The part of an economy that is controlled or owned by the government.

words.ex: He stored the documents in a metal file.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件存放在一个金属档案盒里。
words.en: A file is a box or folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept. As a verb, to file means to put documents in a file or to officially record something.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: They had a formal meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他们昨天开了一次正式会议。
words.en: A formal meeting is a prearranged gathering of people for the purpose of discussing specific topics or making decisions, often following a set agenda and protocol.

words.tr: adj. 印刷的； v. 打印；印刷；“print”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He bought a printed book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一本印刷的书。
words.en: Produced by or involving the process of printing, especially on paper or fabric.

words.ex: The boy got punishment for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩因为打碎了窗户而受到了处罚。
words.en: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or the state of being punished.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: He dismissed her advice and walked away.
words.ex_cn: 他不理会她的建议，走开了。
words.en: If you dismiss someone, you send them away or allow them to leave.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: Many developing countries need more schools and doctors.
words.ex_cn: 许多发展中国家需要更多的学校和医生。
words.en: Countries that are in the process of industrialization and economic development, typically characterized by lower income levels and less advanced infrastructure compared to developed countries.

words.tr: adj. 有成本效益的；划算的
words.ex: This bike is cost-effective and saves money.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车物有所值，能省钱。
words.en: Something that is cost-effective gives the best possible profit or benefits in comparison with the money that is spent.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: He felt proud of his academic achievement.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的学业成就感到自豪。
words.en: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.ex: The company publishes an annual report every year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每年发布一份年度报告。
words.en: A document prepared by a company at the end of each year, giving details of its financial performance and activities over the year.

words.ex: He uses traditional tools to make wooden furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他用传统工具制作木制家具。
words.en: Traditional tools refer to the instruments or devices that have been used for generations in a particular craft or activity, often valued for their historical significance and the skill required to use them.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有效地行动；以有效的方式采取行动
words.ex: He must act effectively to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他必须有效行动来解决问题。
words.en: To perform actions in a manner that produces a desired or intended result.

words.ex: The company sells products in the global market.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在全球市场上销售产品。
words.en: The worldwide arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.ex: The traffic flow is slow during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通流量很慢。
words.en: The movement of vehicles or pedestrians along a street or other route.

words.tr: phrase. 充足；以全文；全部地
words.ex: He paid the bill in full.
words.ex_cn: 他全额支付了账单。
words.en: If something is done or happens in full, it is done or happens completely.

words.ex: The farmer works on his farmland every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上都在他的农田里劳作。
words.en: Land used for or suitable for farming.

words.tr: phrase. 迅速行动；快速采取行动
words.ex: You must act quickly if you want to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 如果你想赶上公交车，就必须迅速行动。
words.en: To do something without delay or hesitation, especially in response to a situation that requires immediate attention.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.tr: phrase. 苏格兰南部（地理区域名称）
words.ex: He lives in southern scotland near the border.
words.ex_cn: 他住在苏格兰南部，靠近边境。
words.en: Southern Scotland: The region of Scotland located in the southern part of the country, including areas like the Borders and Dumfries and Galloway.

words.ex: The children play in smaller areas of the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园较小的区域玩耍。
words.en: A smaller area is a part of a larger space or region.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.ex: My neighbour gives me apples from his tree.
words.ex_cn: 我的邻居从他的树上给我摘苹果。
words.en: A neighbour is someone who lives near you, especially in the next house or flat.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.ex: He likes european painting from the 18th century.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢18世纪的欧洲绘画。
words.en: European painting refers to the visual art produced in Europe from the early medieval period to the present day, encompassing a wide range of styles, movements, and techniques.

words.ex: He made illegal profit by selling fake goods.
words.ex_cn: 他通过销售假冒商品获得非法利润。
words.en: Profit obtained through illegal means, such as fraud, tax evasion, or other unlawful activities.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.tr: phrase. 财务损失；经济损失
words.ex: The company had a financial loss last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年遭受了财务损失。
words.en: A financial loss is a loss of money or decrease in financial value.

words.tr: phrase. 经济危机；指经济活动中出现严重衰退、失业率上升、金融市场动荡等情况
words.ex: The country faced an economic crisis last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家遭遇了经济危机。
words.en: An economic crisis is a situation in which the economy of a country experiences a sudden downturn brought on by a financial crisis.

words.tr: phrase. 背景资料；背景知识
words.ex: He gave us some background information about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我们一些关于这个项目的背景信息。
words.en: Background information refers to the essential details or context that is necessary to understand a particular situation, event, or subject matter fully.

words.ex: The head office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a business or organization, where the most important decisions are made.

words.tr: phrase. 客户关系；与客户之间的互动和联系
words.ex: The company values customer relationships.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视客户关系。
words.en: The connections and interactions a company has with its customers, which are crucial for customer satisfaction and loyalty.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: His aspiration is to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他的渴望是成为一名医生。
words.en: A strong desire to achieve something high or great.

words.tr: phrase. 客户代表；客户服务人员
words.ex: The customer representative helped me with my order.
words.ex_cn: 客服代表帮我处理了订单。
words.en: A customer representative is a person whose job is to help and support customers of a company, especially by answering their questions and dealing with their complaints.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: They meet at the clubhouse every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六在会所见面。
words.en: A clubhouse is a building used by members of a particular club, especially a sports club, for socializing, changing clothes, etc.

words.ex: The students meet in the clubroom after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们放学后在社团室聚会。
words.en: A room or building used by a club for its activities and meetings.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: The new machine improves the efficiency of production.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器提高了生产的效率。
words.en: Efficiency is the ability to do something or produce something without wasting materials, time, or energy.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.tr: n. 习俗；习惯；关税；海关；“custom”的复数；
words.ex: In this village, it is a custom to light lanterns during the festival.
words.ex_cn: 在这个村庄，节日里点灯笼是一种习俗。
words.en: The place at a port, airport, or border where officials check the goods or luggage of people entering or leaving a country, and where they collect taxes on goods being imported.

words.tr: phrase. 财务培训；金融培训
words.ex: He took financial training to manage money better.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了财务培训，以便更好地管理金钱。
words.en: Training related to finance, including the management of money, investments, and other financial instruments.

words.ex: He solved the problem rationally.
words.ex_cn: 他理性地解决了这个问题。
words.en: In a logical and reasonable manner, based on facts or reason rather than emotions or feelings.

words.tr: phrase. 传统犯罪；常规犯罪（指常见的、非政治性的、非组织性的普通刑事犯罪，如盗窃、抢劫等）
words.ex: The police caught a man for conventional crime like theft.
words.ex_cn: 警察抓到了一个犯有盗窃等传统犯罪的人。
words.en: Conventional crime refers to traditional forms of criminal activity, such as theft, burglary, and assault, as opposed to newer forms like cybercrime.

words.ex: He wrote a simple business plan to start a coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份简单的商业计划来开一家咖啡店。
words.en: A business plan is a formal statement of business goals, reasons they are attainable, and plans for reaching them. It may also contain background information about the organization or team attempting to reach those goals.

words.ex: He is learning business management at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习工商管理。
words.en: The process of planning, organizing, directing, and controlling the activities of a business or organization to achieve its objectives.

words.tr: phrase. 商业目的；以盈利为目的的经营活动
words.ex: He uses the photo for commercial purpose.
words.ex_cn: 他把这张照片用于商业目的。
words.en: A commercial purpose refers to any activity or use that is intended for or directed toward commercial advantage or private monetary compensation.

words.tr: phrase. 商业决策；企业决策
words.ex: He makes business decisions every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做商业决策。
words.en: The act of making choices among alternative courses of action in a business context.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.tr: phrase. 清洁设备；清洁用具
words.ex: The school bought new cleaning equipment for the bathrooms.
words.ex_cn: 学校为洗手间买了新的清洁设备。
words.en: Tools and machinery used for cleaning, such as vacuums, mops, and scrubbers.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 清晰的目标；明确的目的
words.ex: He has clear objectives for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的项目设定了明确的目标。
words.en: Clear objectives refer to specific, well-defined goals that are easy to understand and aim to achieve.

words.ex: The fishing industry provides food for many coastal towns.
words.ex_cn: 渔业为许多沿海城镇提供食物。
words.en: The sector of the economy involved in the catching, processing, and selling of fish and other seafood.

words.ex: The boiler heats water for the house.
words.ex_cn: 锅炉为房子加热水。
words.en: A boiler is a device that heats water or produces steam.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.ex: The solution to the problem is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题的解决办法很简单。
words.en: A solution to a problem is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

words.ex: He filled out a comment card after the meal.
words.ex_cn: 他在用餐后填写了一张意见卡。
words.en: A card provided for customers or visitors to write their comments or feedback on a service or product.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.tr:
v. 增加；增多；
n. 增加；增长；
words.ex: The company increased its profits last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司去年增加了利润。
words.en: To increase something means to make it larger in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: phrase. 酒店业； hospitality 业；指提供住宿、餐饮、旅游及相关服务的行业
words.ex: He works in the hospitality industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒店业工作。
words.en: The hospitality industry refers to the sector that includes businesses providing services to customers, such as accommodation, food and drink, and entertainment, in a welcoming and friendly manner.

words.ex: He adds sweetener to his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他往咖啡里加甜味剂。
words.en: A sweetener is a substance used to sweeten food or drink, especially one that does not contain sugar.

words.tr: n. 时事通讯；业务通讯；简报
words.ex: He reads the weekly newsletter every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一都读这份周刊。
words.en: A newsletter is a regularly distributed publication that is generally about one main topic of interest to its subscribers.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 日益增长的需求；不断上升的需求
words.ex: There is a rising demand for clean water.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: An increasing need or desire for a particular product or service.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.tr: n. 标准；尺度；准则；“criterion”的复数；
words.ex: The main criteria for selection are skill and experience.
words.ex_cn: 选择的主要标准是技能和经验。
words.en: A criterion is a standard or principle by which something is judged or decided.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr: phrase. 规划会议；策划会议；筹备会议
words.ex: We had a planning meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一次规划会议。
words.en: A planning meeting is a meeting where people discuss and make plans for future activities or projects.

words.ex: The company wrote a clear mission statement.
words.ex_cn: 公司写了一份清晰的使命宣言。
words.en: A mission statement is a short description of the overall purpose and intention of an organization or individual, typically used to guide decision-making and communicate the organization's goals to stakeholders.

words.tr: phrase. 空间管理；指对物理或虚拟空间进行有效规划、分配与控制的活动
words.ex: He does space management in his small apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他在小公寓里进行空间管理。
words.en: The process of organizing, planning, and controlling the use of space to achieve an organization's objectives.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: He sent his job application yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天寄出了求职申请。
words.en: A document or form that you complete and submit when you are applying for a job.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: He does voluntary work at the animal shelter.
words.ex_cn: 他在动物收容所做志愿工作。
words.en: Voluntary work refers to work that is done by people who are not paid for it, especially work that involves helping others.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: The plane receives radio signals from the tower.
words.ex_cn: 飞机从塔台接收无线电信号。
words.en: Radio signals are electromagnetic waves used to transmit information through space without the need for a physical connection.

words.ex: The company offers 24/7 support services for its software users.
words.ex_cn: 该公司为其软件用户提供24/7技术支持。
words.en: Support services refer to the various forms of assistance provided to individuals or organizations to help them achieve their goals or solve problems. These services can include technical support, customer service, and any other help that supports the main functions of a business or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 未开发地区；未发展的区域
words.ex: The government wants to help people in undeveloped areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府想帮助欠发达地区的人们。
words.en: Areas that have not been developed or built upon, often lacking in infrastructure and services.

words.tr: phrase. 金钱日记；收支记录；个人财务流水账
words.ex: He writes down his money diary every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上记录他的金钱日记。
words.en: A record or journal where one tracks their financial transactions and spending habits.

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: He takes public transport to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天乘公共交通去上班。
words.en: Public transport refers to the system of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.tr: phrase. 故事研讨会；剧本讨论会
words.ex: They attended a story conference last week.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周参加了一个故事会议。
words.en: A meeting where writers, directors, and producers discuss and develop the plot and structure of a story.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: The power company turned off the lights.
words.ex_cn: 电力公司关掉了灯。
words.en: A power company is an organization that generates, transmits, and distributes electricity to consumers.

words.ex: He watches television drama every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视剧。
words.en: A television drama is a type of program that tells a story through a series of episodes, often focusing on character development and emotional themes.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.tr: n. 包装；装箱；包装物； v. “package”的现在分词；
words.ex: The packaging of the gift was very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物的包装非常漂亮。
words.en: The materials in which goods are wrapped or packed, especially commercially.

words.ex: The mayor walks to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 市长每天早上步行上班。
words.en: The mayor of a town or city is the person who has been elected to represent it for a fixed period of time, or, in some places, to run its government.

words.tr: phrase. 市场交易额；市场份额；市场占有率
words.ex: The company increased its market share by lowering prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过降价增加了市场交易额。
words.en: The proportion of industry sales of a particular product or service that is controlled by a company.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: The company will retrain its workers for new machines.
words.ex_cn: 公司会再培训员工以适应新机器。
words.en: To teach someone new skills or to teach them again so that they can do a different job or do their old job in a different way.

words.tr: phrase. 有限的知识；知识面狭窄
words.ex: He has limited knowledge of math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学的了解很有限。
words.en: Limited knowledge refers to a restricted or insufficient understanding or awareness of a particular subject or field.

words.ex: The box has enough storage space for toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有足够的存储空间来放玩具。
words.en: The area or capacity available for storing data, files, or other materials in a computer or other device.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.tr: phrase. 传统产业；传统工业
words.ex: Many workers in the traditional industry are worried about losing their jobs.
words.ex_cn: 许多传统行业的工人担心会失去工作。
words.en: Traditional industry refers to industries that have been established for a long time, often involving manual labor and older technologies, as opposed to modern or high-tech industries.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.ex: He wore a name card on his chest during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间佩戴了一块胸牌。
words.en: A small card printed with one's name, professional occupation, company position, business address, etc., used in business or social introductions.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr: phrase. 和平的环境；宁静的氛围
words.ex: The library offers a peaceful environment for studying.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆为学习提供了一个安静的环境。
words.en: A peaceful environment refers to a setting or atmosphere that is calm, quiet, and free from disturbance or conflict, conducive to peace and tranquility.

words.ex: He got a driving licence last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾驶执照。
words.en: A licence is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr: n. 航运；船运；运输； v. 装运；“ship”的现在分词；
words.ex: The shipping industry moves goods across oceans.
words.ex_cn: 航运业将货物运过海洋。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.tr: phrase. 技术支持；为用户提供的技术帮助与服务
words.ex: The technician gave me technical support for my computer.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员为我的电脑提供了技术支持。
words.en: Technical support refers to a range of services providing assistance with technology products such as mobile phones, televisions, computers, software products or other electronic or mechanical goods. In general, technical support services attempt to help the user solve specific problems with a product—rather than providing training, customization, or other support services.

words.ex: The teacher maintains strict control over the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂保持严格管理。
words.en: Strict control refers to the rigorous regulation or management of something to ensure compliance with specific standards or rules.

words.tr:
n. 劳动；体力劳动；劳工；
v. 辛勤工作；
words.ex: Hard labour helps people build strong skills.
words.ex_cn: 辛勤的劳动帮助人们培养强大的技能。
words.en: Labour is very hard work, especially physical work. It can also refer to the workers of a country or industry, considered as a group, or the process of childbirth.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 周播喜剧节目；每周一期的喜剧表演
words.ex: He watches a weekly comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他每周在电视上看一部喜剧。
words.en: A comedy show or program that is broadcast or performed once a week.

words.ex: The sandglass shows the time by falling sand.
words.ex_cn: 沙漏通过落下的沙子显示时间。
words.en: A sandglass is a device that measures time by the flow of sand from one glass bulb to another, typically taking a fixed amount of time to do so.

words.ex: The social worker helps poor families.
words.ex_cn: 社会工作者帮助贫困家庭。
words.en: A social worker is a person whose job is to help people in a particular area who have social disadvantages or personal problems.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.tr: phrase. 矿产资源；矿物资源
words.ex: The country has rich mineral resources.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家拥有丰富的矿产资源。
words.en: Mineral resources refer to the natural concentrations of minerals or, in some cases, elements in the Earth's crust that are of economic interest. These resources are extracted for use in various industries and are essential for the production of goods and services.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.ex: He works in international trade.
words.ex_cn: 他从事国际贸易。
words.en: The exchange of goods and services between countries.

words.ex: The shopper bought apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位购物者在市场买了苹果。
words.en: A shopper is a person who is shopping or who is looking to buy goods from stores.

words.ex: This is the latest version of the app.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个应用的最新版本。
words.en: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

words.tr: phrase. 服务业；服务行业（指提供服务而非生产实物的经济部门）
words.ex: He works in the service industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在服务业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy that provides services rather than goods.

words.tr: phrase. 个人客户；个体消费者
words.ex: The shop serves individual customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每天为单个顾客服务。
words.en: Customers who purchase goods or services for personal use rather than for business or resale purposes.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: He uses a tape recorder to practice English.
words.ex_cn: 他用录音机练习英语。
words.en: A tape recorder is a device used for recording and playing back sound on magnetic tape.

words.ex: The organisation helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organisation is a group of people who work together in a structured way for a shared purpose.

words.ex: He has strong organisational skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有很强的组织能力。
words.en: Organisational skills refer to the ability to use your time, energy, resources, etc. in an effective way so that you achieve the things you want to achieve.

words.tr: v.经过重新培训的（动词retrain的过去分词）
words.ex: He was retrained to work as a technician.
words.ex_cn: 他被重新培训成为技术人员。
words.en: If someone is retrained, or if they retrain, they learn new skills, especially in order to get a new job.

words.tr: phrase. 选择程序；选拔流程
words.ex: The selection procedure takes two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 选拔程序需要两周时间。
words.en: A selection procedure is a method or process used to choose someone or something from a group of candidates or options.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr: n. 视角；观点；（对事物的）合理判断；
words.ex: His perspective on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的看法非常积极。
words.en: A particular attitude towards or way of regarding something; a point of view.

words.tr: phrase. 信息行业；信息产业
words.ex: The information sector grows fast in this country.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的信息产业增长很快。
words.en: The part of the economy that involves the production, processing, and distribution of information.

words.ex: He won a gold medal in the Olympics.
words.ex_cn: 他在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A medal is a small metal disc which is given as an award for bravery or as a prize in a sporting event.

words.tr: adj. 已退休的；已退职的； v. 退休；“retire”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My retired grandfather walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我已退休的爷爷每天早上都在公园散步。
words.en: Having left one's job and ceased to work.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: He works in shipbuilding near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边从事造船工作。
words.en: The industry or activity of building ships.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.tr: n. 领导才能；领导地位；
words.ex: His leadership helped the team win the match.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导才能帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Leadership is the ability to lead, guide, or direct a group, organization, or country.

words.ex: His leadership style is calm and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的领导风格冷静而公正。
words.en: A leadership style refers to a leader's methods and behaviors when directing, motivating, and managing others.

words.ex: The trader sells fruits every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位商人每天早上卖水果。
words.en: A trader is a person who buys and sells goods, currencies, or shares.

words.ex: He made business visits to Japan last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月去日本进行了商务访问。
words.en: Business visits refer to trips made by individuals or groups for the purpose of conducting business activities, such as meetings, negotiations, or market research, in a location different from their usual place of work.

words.ex: He gave a situational answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个情境相关的回答。
words.en: Relating to or dependent on a set of circumstances or state of affairs.

words.ex: His expectation was to pass the test.
words.ex_cn: 他的期待是通过考试。
words.en: An expectation is a belief about what might happen in the future, especially about something that you think is likely or that you hope will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 连接；联合；团结；合并
words.ex: They join together to build a house.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起合作盖房子。
words.en: To connect or unite two or more things into a single entity or whole.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.tr: phrase. 销售团队；销售部门
words.ex: The sales team called the customer yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 销售团队昨天联系了客户。
words.en: A group of individuals within a company who are responsible for selling products or services.

words.tr: phrase. 流浪儿童；街头儿童（指无家可归或在街头生活、谋生的未成年人）
words.ex: Street children sleep on the sidewalks and beg for food.
words.ex_cn: 街头儿童睡在人行道上，乞讨食物。
words.en: Street children are minors who live and survive on the streets of a city, town, or village, often without adequate adult supervision or care.

words.tr: phrase. 新产品；新上市的产品
words.ex: The company will launch new products next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将推出新产品。
words.en: New products refer to goods or services recently introduced to the market by a company.

words.tr: phrase. 舞台制作；舞台剧演出
words.ex: The school put on a stage production last month.
words.ex_cn: 学校上个月举办了一场舞台剧。
words.en: The process of producing a theatrical performance, including the design and construction of sets, costumes, and lighting, as well as the direction of actors.

words.tr: phrase. 管理技能；经营能力；管理技巧
words.ex: He has good management skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中有很好的管理技能。
words.en: Management skills refer to the abilities that an individual possesses to effectively lead, organize, and oversee the work of others to achieve specific goals.

words.ex: He cooks with olive oil every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都用橄榄油做饭。
words.en: Olive oil is a liquid fat obtained from olives, a traditional tree crop of the Mediterranean Basin. It is commonly used in cooking, for frying foods or as a salad dressing.

words.tr: phrase. 暴力犯罪；指涉及身体伤害或威胁使用暴力的犯罪行为
words.ex: The city saw a rise in violent crime last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个城市的暴力犯罪增加了。
words.en: A violent crime is a crime in which the offender uses or threatens to use violent force upon the victim.

words.tr: phrase. （儿童学习认知方面的）时间和顺序，时间感和顺序感
words.ex: Children learn time and sequence by arranging pictures of a day's activities.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过排列一天活动的图片来学习时间和顺序。
words.en: The arrangement or order of events in relation to one another.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr: phrase. 医学检查；体检；医疗检测
words.ex: He had medical tests last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周做了医学检查。
words.en: Medical tests are procedures performed to detect, diagnose, or monitor diseases, disease processes, susceptibility, or to determine a course of treatment.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: Flu is a common disease in winter.
words.ex_cn: 流感是冬天常见的疾病。
words.en: A disease that is frequently encountered or widely prevalent among a population.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: He goes upstairs to bed.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉。
words.en: To move from a lower level to a higher level within a building, especially by walking up steps.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.ex: The noise from the construction caused a disturbance.
words.ex_cn: 建筑工地的噪音造成了干扰。
words.en: A disturbance is an event or situation in which people behave in a noisy or violent way, or something that interrupts what you are doing.

words.ex: He developed a disease after eating bad food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了坏食物后生病了。
words.en: To become affected by a medical condition or illness over time, often as a result of genetic, environmental, or lifestyle factors.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: He has a high fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，躺在床上休息。
words.en: A fever is a condition in which the body's temperature is higher than usual, often as a response to infection.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: He washes his hands before meals.
words.ex_cn: 他饭前洗手。
words.en: Prior to eating food.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.tr: phrase. 本地医生；当地医师
words.ex: Local doctors helped the injured people.
words.ex_cn: 当地的医生帮助了受伤的人。
words.en: Doctors who practice in a specific community or region, typically providing primary care to local residents.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.ex_cn: 他的年龄是25岁。
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr: phrase. 传统方法；惯例做法
words.ex: He still uses the traditional method to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然用传统方法解决数学问题。
words.en: A traditional method is a way of doing something that has been used for a long time and is considered the usual way.

words.tr:
adj. 寒冷的；冰冷的；
n. 寒冷；
words.ex: The cold wind made me shiver.
words.ex_cn: 寒冷的风让我发抖。
words.en: Something that is cold has a low temperature, especially when compared to the temperature of the human body. It can also describe a lack of warmth in someone's behavior or a situation.

words.ex: He checks his blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上测量血压。
words.en: The force that blood exerts against the walls of the blood vessels, especially the arteries, as it is pumped around the body by the heart.

words.tr: phrase. 血液系统；血液循环系统，指人体内负责输送血液、氧气和养分的器官和血管网络
words.ex: The blood system carries oxygen to all parts of the body.
words.ex_cn: 血液循环系统将氧气输送到身体的各个部分。
words.en: The blood system, also known as the circulatory system, is an organ system that permits blood to circulate and transport nutrients, oxygen, carbon dioxide, hormones, and blood cells to and from the cells in the body to nourish it and help to fight diseases, stabilize body temperature and pH, and to maintain homeostasis.

words.ex: He put an ice pack on his knee after the injury.
words.ex_cn: 他在膝盖受伤后敷了一个冰袋。
words.en: A bag filled with ice or a gel that can be frozen, used to cool an injury or to keep food cold.

words.ex: He closes the eyes when he sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉时闭上眼睛。
words.en: To shut one's eyes; to cease to look at something.

words.tr: phrase. 运动科学；研究体育锻炼和身体活动对人类健康与表现影响的学科
words.ex: He is studying exercise science at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习运动科学。
words.en: The study of the movement of the body and how it relates to health and physical performance, often involving research into how exercise affects the body and how the body adapts to physical activity.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.tr: phrase. 公共医疗卫生服务
words.ex: The health service helps people get free check-ups.
words.ex_cn: 医疗服务帮助人们获得免费体检。
words.en: Health service refers to the medical services provided to the public, often by a government or private organization, aimed at maintaining or improving people's health.

words.ex: He needs enough sleep to feel good.
words.ex_cn: 他需要足够的睡眠来感觉良好。
words.en: Sufficient sleep to feel rested and healthy.

words.ex: He has dietary problems because he eats too much sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他因为吃太多糖而有饮食方面的问题。
words.en: Issues related to the intake of food and nutrients, often causing health problems.

words.tr: phrase. 诊所预约；门诊预约
words.ex: He has a clinic appointment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一个诊所预约。
words.en: An arrangement to meet a doctor or other medical professional at a clinic at a particular time.

words.ex: The coffee had a strong bitterness.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有很重的苦味。
words.en: Bitterness is the quality of having a sharp, pungent taste or of feeling angry and unhappy because of bad experiences.

words.ex: Reading a book gives me relaxation.
words.ex_cn: 读书让我放松。
words.en: Relaxation is the state or process of becoming less tense, anxious, or stressed.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: He felt drowsiness after taking the medicine.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完药后感到困倦。
words.en: A state of feeling sleepy or lethargic, often leading to a desire to sleep.

words.tr: phrase. 晚间服务；晚间礼拜；晚餐服务
words.ex: The church holds an evening service every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 教堂每周五举行晚间礼拜。
words.en: An evening service is a religious service that takes place in the evening, often in a church or other place of worship.

words.ex: The doctor gave him proper treatment for the infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他提供了针对感染的适当治疗。
words.en: The act or manner of treating someone or something, especially in a medical context.

words.tr: phrase. 治疗咳嗽的药物；止咳药
words.ex: He took cough medicine to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他服了止咳药以感觉好些。
words.en: Cough medicine is a type of medication used to treat coughs. It can come in various forms, such as syrups, tablets, or lozenges, and may contain ingredients to soothe the throat, suppress the cough reflex, or loosen phlegm.

words.ex: His eyesight is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的视力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

words.tr: phrase. 细胞变化；指细胞在形态、结构或功能上的改变
words.ex: The doctor saw a cellular change in the tissue sample.
words.ex_cn: 医生在组织样本中发现了细胞变化。
words.en: A modification in the structure or function of cells, often due to disease, aging, or environmental factors.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.tr: phrase. 规律运动；经常锻炼
words.ex: He does regular exercises to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他做规律的锻炼来保持健康。
words.en: Physical activities performed consistently to maintain or improve health and fitness.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在药店买了药。
words.en: A drugstore is a shop where medicines and other small items are sold.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed a drug for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他开了一种治疗头痛的药物。
words.en: A drug is a substance which is used to treat an illness, relieve a symptom, or modify a chemical process in the body for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.tr: 短语动词. 适量进食；有节制地饮食
words.ex: He eats in moderation to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他适量饮食以保持健康。
words.en: To consume food or drink in a reasonable and controlled manner, avoiding excess.

words.ex: He keeps a first-aid kit in his car.
words.ex_cn: 他把急救包放在车里。
words.en: A first-aid kit is a collection of supplies and equipment that is used to give medical treatment.

words.ex: He wrote his emergency contact on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他在表格上写了紧急联系人。
words.en: A person or entity designated to be contacted in case of an emergency.

words.tr: phrase. 胸部感染；指影响肺部或气道的感染，如支气管炎或肺炎
words.ex: He has a chest infection and can't breathe well.
words.ex_cn: 他得了胸部感染，呼吸不好。
words.en: A chest infection is an infection that affects your lungs, either in the larger airways (bronchitis) or in the smaller air sacs (pneumonia).

words.ex: The brain controls our thoughts and movements.
words.ex_cn: 大脑控制我们的思想和行动。
words.en: The brain is the organ inside your head that controls your body's activities and enables you to think and to feel things such as heat and pain.

words.ex: The doctor read the patient's case history.
words.ex_cn: 医生阅读了病人的病历。
words.en: A detailed account of a person's medical background or a record of the development of a particular situation or condition over time.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr: phrase. 消化问题；消化系统不适
words.ex: He has digestive problems after eating spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完辛辣食物后有消化问题。
words.en: Issues related to the process of breaking down food in the body for absorption and assimilation.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: My family members eat dinner together every night.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人每天晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Family members are individuals related by blood, marriage, or adoption, who form a household together.

words.tr: phrase. 被动学习者；消极接受知识的人
words.ex: He is a passive learner who never asks questions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个从不提问的被动学习者。
words.en: A passive learner is someone who does not take an active role in their learning process, often relying on others to provide information and direction.

words.tr: phrase. 预期持续时间；预计的持续时长
words.ex: The expected duration of the trip is two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的预计时长是两周。
words.en: The period of time that is anticipated or predicted to last.

words.tr: phrase. 体能测试；评估个人身体素质和健康状况的测试过程
words.ex: The students did fitness testing last week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们上周进行了体能测试。
words.en: The process of evaluating the physical condition and capabilities of an individual through various exercises and measurements.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: He uses eye drops when his eyes are itchy.
words.ex_cn: 当他的眼睛发痒时，他会使用眼药水。
words.en: A liquid medicine that is administered into the eyes to treat various eye conditions or to moisturize dry eyes.

words.tr: phrase. 晚间的约会或预约
words.ex: I have an evening appointment at 7 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我晚上七点有一个预约。
words.en: An evening appointment is a scheduled meeting or consultation that takes place in the late afternoon or night.

words.ex: He has a decayed tooth and needs to see a dentist.
words.ex_cn: 他有一颗蛀牙，需要去看牙医。
words.en: A tooth that has been damaged by decay.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.ex: He drinks milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝牛奶。
words.en: Consume milk as a beverage.

words.ex: The painting shows a beautiful contrast of dark and light.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了明暗的美丽对比。
words.en: Refers to the contrast between dark and light colors or tones.

words.ex: The concept of freedom is important in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 自由这个观念在许多国家都很重要。
words.en: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

words.ex: He has back pain after lifting heavy boxes.
words.ex_cn: 他搬重箱子后背痛。
words.en: Pain felt in the back, often in the lower back.

words.ex: He has a back problem from sitting too long.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坐得太久而有背部问题。
words.en: A back problem refers to any issue or condition affecting the back, including pain, injury, or disease.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He uses natural medicine to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他使用天然药物来感觉好些。
words.en: Natural medicine refers to a system of healthcare that uses natural remedies and the body's vital ability to heal and maintain itself. It includes a variety of treatments, such as herbal medicine, acupuncture, and dietary changes.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: He has a toothache and cannot eat.
words.ex_cn: 他牙疼，不能吃东西。
words.en: A toothache is a pain in or around a tooth.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: She buys convenience food for dinner because she is tired.
words.ex_cn: 她因为累了，所以买即食食品当晚餐。
words.en: Convenience food refers to food that is commercially prepared and designed for ease of consumption, often requiring minimal preparation by the consumer.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.ex: He has heart disease and must eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他患有心脏病，必须吃健康的食物。
words.en: A condition that affects the heart and blood vessels, often leading to serious health issues.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.tr: phrase. 旧伤；旧日的心理创伤
words.ex: The old wound still hurts when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 当天下雨时，旧伤口仍然会疼。
words.en: An old wound refers to a past injury, either physical or emotional, that has not completely healed or has been reopened.

words.ex: The bird knows when to fly south by its internal clock.
words.ex_cn: 鸟通过它的生物钟知道何时飞往南方。
words.en: An internal clock is a natural mechanism within living organisms that regulates the timing of physiological processes and behaviors, such as sleep cycles, in accordance with the environment.

words.tr: n. 寿命；使用寿命；生命期；
words.ex: The lifespan of a housefly is only a few weeks.
words.ex_cn: 家蝇的寿命只有几周。
words.en: The length of time for which a person or animal lives or a thing functions.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: The job offers good health benefits.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作提供良好的医疗福利。
words.en: Health benefits refer to the positive effects on health that result from certain actions, such as exercise, diet, or abstaining from harmful habits.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.tr: phrase. 香烟数量；香烟支数
words.ex: He counts the number of cigarettes he smokes each day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天数自己抽的香烟数量。
words.en: The count of cigarettes, often used in health or sales contexts.

words.tr: phrase. 网络成瘾；对互联网的病态依赖
words.ex: He has internet addiction and plays games all day.
words.ex_cn: 他有网络成瘾，整天玩游戏。
words.en: Internet addiction refers to the excessive use of the internet that interferes with daily life.

words.tr: phrase. 娱乐疗法；通过有组织的休闲活动促进身心健康与康复的治疗方法
words.ex: He uses recreation therapy to feel better after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他通过娱乐疗法在受伤后让自己感觉更好。
words.en: Recreation therapy involves the use of leisure activities to improve the physical, emotional, and mental well-being of individuals.

words.tr: phrase. 合理的饮食；明智的进食方式
words.ex: He practices sensible eating to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他通过合理饮食来保持健康。
words.en: Sensible eating refers to the practice of making wise and healthy food choices that contribute to overall well-being and prevent health issues.

words.ex: He takes sleeping pills to help him sleep at night.
words.ex_cn: 他服用安眠药来帮助晚上入睡。
words.en: Sleeping pills are medicines that help people to sleep.

words.ex: He got a sports injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了运动损伤。
words.en: An injury that occurs as a result of participating in sports or physical activities.

words.tr: phrase. 听力问题；听觉障碍
words.ex: He has a hearing problem and uses a hearing aid.
words.ex_cn: 他有听力问题，使用助听器。
words.en: A condition or impairment that affects a person's ability to hear sounds clearly or at all.

words.tr: phrase. 个人护理；个人卫生；个人保健
words.ex: He buys personal care products every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都买个人护理用品。
words.en: The practice of looking after one's own health and wellbeing, especially through hygiene and grooming.

words.tr: phrase. 体力活动；身体运动
words.ex: He does physical activity every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上进行体育活动。
words.en: Physical activity refers to any bodily movement produced by skeletal muscles that requires energy expenditure.

words.ex: You should have a health check every year.
words.ex_cn: 你应该每年做一次健康检查。
words.en: A health check is a medical examination to test your general state of health.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.tr: phrase. 身体不适；生理上的不舒适感
words.ex: He felt physical discomfort after running too long.
words.ex_cn: 他跑太久后感到身体不适。
words.en: Physical discomfort refers to a state of unease or pain in the body, often as a result of illness, injury, or strain.

words.tr: phrase. 医学疾病；医疗失调
words.ex: He has some medical disorders that need special care.
words.ex_cn: 他有一些需要特别护理的医学疾病。
words.en: Medical disorders refer to conditions that affect the normal functioning of the body or mind, leading to symptoms that can impact an individual's health and well-being.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr: phrase. 饮食习惯；进食方式
words.ex: His eating habits are very unhealthy.
words.ex_cn: 他的饮食习惯非常不健康。
words.en: Eating habits refer to the way a person or group eats, including the types of food chosen, the manner of eating, and the frequency of meals.

words.tr: phrase. 失去食欲；胃口减退
words.ex: He loses appetite when he is stressed.
words.ex_cn: 他一紧张就没了胃口。
words.en: To experience a decrease in the desire to eat.

words.ex: He drank water to help his kidney work better.
words.ex_cn: 他喝水以帮助肾脏更好地工作。
words.en: One of the two organs in your lower back that separate waste products from your blood and make urine.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 肺部感染；肺部炎症
words.ex: He has a lung infection and needs rest.
words.ex_cn: 他得了肺部感染，需要休息。
words.en: An infection that affects the lungs, which can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: He works the night shift at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院上夜班。
words.en: A night shift is a period of work that occurs during the night, typically from late evening to early morning, in various industries and services.

words.ex: He got malaria from a mosquito bite.
words.ex_cn: 他被蚊子叮咬后得了疟疾。
words.en: Malaria is a disease caused by a parasite that is transmitted to humans through the bites of infected mosquitoes.

words.ex: He takes a warm bath before bed.
words.ex_cn: 他睡前洗个温水澡。
words.en: A warm bath is a bath in which the water is comfortably warm, typically used for relaxation or to relieve muscle pain.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: The doctor suggested a natural remedy for the cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生建议了一种治疗感冒的天然疗法。
words.en: A remedy is a cure or a way of making something better.

words.tr: n. 平板电脑；（刻有文字的）匾；
words.ex: He uses a tablet to read books.
words.ex_cn: 他用平板电脑读书。
words.en: A tablet is a small, flat computer that is controlled by touching the screen. It can also refer to a small, solid piece of medicine that you swallow.

words.tr: n. 药物；药物治疗；药物处理；
words.ex: He took his medication every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: Medication refers to a substance used for medical treatment, especially a medicine or drug.

words.ex: He works at a small pharmacy near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他在公园附近的一家小药房工作。
words.en: A pharmacy is a shop or a department in a shop where medicines are prepared and sold.

words.ex: The saltiness of the soup made it taste too strong.
words.ex_cn: 汤的咸味让它味道太重了。
words.en: The quality or state of being salty.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: He had a stomachache after eating too much ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了太多冰淇淋后胃痛。
words.en: A stomachache is a pain in your stomach.

words.ex: He shows strong mental ability in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很强的思维能力。
words.en: The capacity of an individual to perform the higher mental processes of reasoning, remembering, understanding, and problem solving.

words.ex: He tracks his food intake every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天记录自己的食物摄入量。
words.en: The amount of food consumed by an organism or individual.

words.tr: phrase. 热巧克力；巧克力热饮
words.ex: He drinks hot chocolate every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上喝热巧克力。
words.en: A hot beverage made from chocolate or cocoa powder, sugar, and milk or water, typically served warm.

words.tr: phrase. 睡眠不足；缺乏睡眠
words.ex: He feels tired because of lack of sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他因为睡眠不足而感到疲倦。
words.en: The condition of not having enough sleep, which can lead to various health issues.

words.tr: n. 倾听；收听； v. 听；“listen”的现在分词；
words.ex: Good listening helps you understand others.
words.ex_cn: 良好的倾听能帮助你理解他人。
words.en: The act of paying attention to and trying to hear something.

words.ex: He eats vegetables and runs every day to live a healthy lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃蔬菜并跑步，以保持健康的生活方式。
words.en: A way of living that lowers the risk of being seriously ill or dying early. Not all diseases are preventable, but a large proportion of deaths, particularly those from coronary heart disease and lung cancer, can be avoided.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: He has a high fever as a symptom of the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧是流感的症状。
words.en: A symptom is a physical or mental feature which is regarded as indicating a condition of disease, particularly such a feature that is apparent to the patient.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: He took sick leave because he had a fever.
words.ex_cn: 他因为发烧请了病假。
words.en: Sick leave is a period of time that an employee is allowed to be away from work because of illness.

words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.ex: He got yellow fever while traveling in Africa.
words.ex_cn: 他在非洲旅行时感染了黄热病。
words.en: Yellow fever is a serious viral disease that is transmitted by mosquitoes, primarily in tropical regions of Africa and South America. It is characterized by fever, chills, severe headache, back pain, general body aches, nausea, and vomiting. In severe cases, it can cause liver damage leading to jaundice (which gives the disease its name), bleeding, and even death.

words.ex: Eating vegetables gives you good nutrition.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜能提供良好的营养。
words.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: The child has low nutrition because he eats few vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子营养不良，因为他吃很少的蔬菜。
words.en: A state where the body does not receive enough nutrients to maintain health.

words.tr: phrase. 定期检查；例行检查
words.ex: He has a regular check every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月进行一次常规检查。
words.en: A routine examination or inspection to ensure that something is in order or functioning correctly.

words.ex: The sweetness of the honey made her smile.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜的甜蜜让她露出了微笑。
words.en: The quality of being sweet.

words.tr:
n. 液体；
adj. 液态的；
words.ex: Water is a common liquid.
words.ex_cn: 水是一种常见的液体。
words.en: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

words.tr: phrase. 足够的细节；充分的详情
words.ex: The report does not have sufficient details.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告没有足够的细节。
words.en: Enough information or particulars to meet a requirement or purpose.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He hurt his neck while lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他在举重时伤了脖子。
words.en: The part of a person's or animal's body connecting the head to the rest of the body.

words.tr: phrase. 释放压力；缓解压力
words.ex: She listens to music to release stress.
words.ex_cn: 她听音乐来释放压力。
words.en: To release stress means to free oneself from the pressures and tensions that accumulate in daily life, often through activities or practices that promote relaxation and well-being.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.tr: phrase. 睡眠障碍；睡眠失调
words.ex: He has a sleeping disorder and cannot rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 他有睡眠障碍，晚上无法休息。
words.en: A condition that negatively affects a person's ability to sleep well on a regular basis.

words.ex: He has a sore throat from singing too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因为唱太多歌而喉咙痛。
words.en: If you have a sore throat, your throat hurts and it is difficult for you to swallow.

words.tr: phrase. 腿部力量；下肢力量
words.ex: He improves his leg strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强腿部力量。
words.en: The physical power and endurance of the muscles in the legs, important for various physical activities and sports.

words.ex: The sun burns bare skin quickly.
words.ex_cn: 阳光很快晒伤裸露的皮肤。
words.en: The skin that is not covered by any clothing or protection.

words.ex: The sourness of the lemon made her face twist.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬的酸味让她皱起了脸。
words.en: The quality or state of being sour; acidity or bitterness in taste or character.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.tr: phrase. 课后托管；放学后的儿童照管服务
words.ex: The children go to after-school care after class ends.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们下课后去课后托管。
words.en: Supervision provided for children after the school day ends, typically including activities and assistance with homework.

words.tr: phrase. 大家庭；人口众多的家庭
words.ex: Large families often live together in one house.
words.ex_cn: 大家庭通常住在一起。
words.en: Large families refer to families that have many members, typically more than the average number of children.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: He looked up the number in the electronic directory.
words.ex_cn: 他在电子目录中查找了这个号码。
words.en: An electronic directory is a digital or computerized list or database that provides information, such as contact details, addresses, and other relevant data, organized in a way that is accessible through electronic means.

words.tr: phrase. 办公用途；内部使用；仅限办公室使用
words.ex: This printer is for office use only.
words.ex_cn: 这台打印机仅限办公室使用。
words.en: Intended for or suitable for use in an office environment.

words.ex: He used a photo card to send a message.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张照片卡片发送了一条信息。
words.en: A photo card is a card that features a photograph, often used for sending messages or as a collectible item.

words.tr: phrase. 现代捕鱼；现代渔业
words.ex: He uses modern fishing tools to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他使用现代捕鱼工具来捕鱼。
words.en: Modern fishing refers to the use of advanced technology and methods in the practice of catching fish, aimed at increasing efficiency and sustainability.

words.ex: The actor waits at the stage door after the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员在演出后在侧门等候。
words.en: The entrance at the back of a theater used by performers and staff, often where fans wait to meet actors after a performance.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: He drinks water every 40 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 他每40分钟喝一次水。
words.en: Occurring once in each 40-minute interval.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.tr: phrase. 三个步骤；三步（常指完成某事所需的三个阶段或动作）
words.ex: He solved the problem in three steps.
words.ex_cn: 他用三步解决了这个问题。
words.en: A sequence of three actions or processes that are followed to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: He won third prize in the science competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在科学竞赛中获得了三等奖。
words.en: A prize awarded for coming in third place in a competition.

words.ex: She ate a slice of toast for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片烤面包。
words.en: Toast is bread which has been cut into slices and made brown and crisp by cooking at a high temperature. Toast is also a drink in which you wish someone happiness or success.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.tr: phrase. 天蓝色的；蔚蓝色的
words.ex: The sky is sky blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是天蓝色的。
words.en: A light, bright blue color resembling the sky on a clear day.

words.tr: phrase. 无线电通信；利用无线电波进行的信息传输
words.ex: The sailors use radio communication to talk to the shore.
words.ex_cn: 水手们使用无线电通信与陆地联系。
words.en: Radio communication refers to the technology of using radio waves to carry information, such as sound, by systematically modulating properties of electromagnetic energy waves transmitted through space, such as their amplitude, frequency, phase, or pulse width.

words.ex: He bought timber to build a fence.
words.ex_cn: 他买了木材来建篱笆。
words.en: Wood prepared for use in building and carpentry.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
