words.ex: The photo showed an enlargement of the tiny letter.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了那个小字母的放大版。
words.en: The act of making something larger or the state of being made larger.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: She ate delicious Mexican food at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 她在餐厅吃了美味的墨西哥食物。
words.en: Relating to Mexico or its people.

words.ex: The school has a picture library for students to use.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个图片库供学生使用。
words.en: A collection of pictures, photographs, or images stored and organized for use, reference, or loan.

words.ex: The baby smiled at the sweet melody.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝听到了甜美的旋律，笑了。
words.en: A melody is a sequence of single notes that is musically satisfying.

words.tr:
n. 盖屋顶的材料；盖屋顶
v. 给…盖顶；“roof”的现在分词
words.ex: He is installing roofing on the house.
words.ex_cn: 他正在给房子安装屋顶。
words.en: Roofing refers to the material used to cover a roof or the process of covering a roof.

words.ex: A crow sat on the tree branch.
words.ex_cn: 一只乌鸦坐在树枝上。
words.en: A crow is a large black bird which makes a loud, harsh noise. If someone crows, they talk in a very proud way about something they have done or achieved.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: The government introduced a green tax to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府征收了一项环保税以减少污染。
words.en: A green tax is a tax levied on activities that are harmful to the environment, aimed at encouraging businesses and individuals to adopt more environmentally friendly practices.

words.tr: n. 穿衣； v. “dress”的现在分词；
words.ex: Every morning, she makes a quick dressing before leaving home.
words.ex_cn: 每天早上，她出门前都会快速穿衣。
words.en: A dressing is a sauce, especially one consisting of oil and vinegar mixed together with herbs or other flavorings, which you put on salad or other foods.

words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.ex: The park is 12,000㎡ large.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园有12,000平方米大。
words.en: An area measurement equal to twelve thousand square metres.

words.tr:
n. 热度；热；
v. 加热；
words.ex: The heat of the sun made the road hot.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的热度让路面变得很热。
words.en: Heat is a form of energy that is transferred by a difference in temperature. It can also refer to the level of excitement or intensity in a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 蓝色的大门；蓝色门
words.ex: He waits at the blue gate after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在蓝色的门那里等候。
words.en: A gate that is colored blue, often used for identification or decoration.

words.tr:
n. 喷雾；
v. 喷洒；
words.ex: She used a spray to clean the window.
words.ex_cn: 她用喷雾清洁了窗户。
words.en: Spray can refer to a liquid that is blown or driven through the air in the form of tiny drops, or to the act of applying such a liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 商业街；市中心的主要购物街道
words.ex: She bought a dress on the high street.
words.ex_cn: 她在主街上买了一条裙子。
words.en: The main street of a town, especially as the traditional site for most shops, banks, and other businesses.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.tr: phrase. 国家公园；“national park”的复数
words.ex: Many families visit national parks on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭在周末参观国家公园。
words.en: National parks are areas of land protected by the government for the conservation of wildlife, plants, and landscapes, and for public enjoyment and recreation.

words.ex: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the word.
words.ex_cn: 词典给出了这个词的清晰定义。
words.en: A statement of the exact meaning of a word, phrase, or concept.

words.ex: He buys cold drinks after playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他踢完足球后买冷饮。
words.en: Cold drinks refer to beverages that are served cold, typically to refresh or cool down the body, especially in hot weather.

words.ex: He ate a big birthday cake with candles.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块大生日蛋糕，上面有蜡烛。
words.en: A cake made and decorated to celebrate someone's birthday, typically with the person's name and age written on it in icing, and often with candles.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The weather was predictable today, just like yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气和昨天一样，是可以预见的。
words.en: If you say that an event or a situation is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen or what it will be like.

words.tr: phrase. 公园公寓；位于公园附近或带有公园景观的公寓
words.ex: They live in park apartments near the river.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在河边的公园公寓里。
words.en: Residential buildings situated in or near a park.

words.ex: He connects his phone to the wi-fi at home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家把手机连接到无线网络。
words.en: Wi-Fi is a system for connecting electronic equipment to the internet without using wires, by using radio signals.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.tr: adj. 引起烦恼的；令人不安的； v. 打扰；妨碍；“disturb”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie showed a disturbing scene of violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个引起烦恼的暴力场景。
words.en: If you describe something as disturbing, you mean that it makes you feel anxious or upset.

words.ex: He plays the clarinet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹单簧管。
words.en: A clarinet is a musical instrument of the woodwind family in the shape of a pipe. You play the clarinet by blowing into it and covering and uncovering the holes with your fingers.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.ex_cn: 他每四年观看奥运会。
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.tr:
n. 清漆；漆面；光泽面
v. 给…涂上清漆
words.ex: He put varnish on the wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 他在木桌上涂了清漆。
words.en: Varnish is a transparent, hard, protective finish or film primarily used in wood finishing but also for other materials. Varnish is traditionally a combination of a drying oil, a resin, and a thinner or solvent.

words.ex: Dogs produce saliva when they smell food.
words.ex_cn: 狗闻到食物时会分泌唾液。
words.en: Saliva is the watery liquid that forms in your mouth and helps you to chew and digest food.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: She sends emails to helen@greenworld.com every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周一给 helen@greenworld.com 发邮件。
words.en: An email address for a person named Helen, associated with the domain 'greenworld.com', likely for professional or organizational communication.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.tr: v. 劈砍；侵入（计算机等）
words.ex: He hacked the tree with an axe.
words.ex_cn: 他用斧头劈砍那棵树。
words.en: To hack means to cut or chop something with rough or heavy blows, or to gain unauthorized access to data in a system or computer.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

words.tr:
n. 步；步骤；踏级；步伐；
v. 踩；踏；行走；
words.ex: He took a small step forward.
words.ex_cn: 他向前迈了一小步。
words.en: A step is an act or movement of putting one leg in front of the other in order to move forward, or a stage in a process.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假日去了海滩。
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.tr:
v. 微笑；
n. 微笑；
words.ex: I smile every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天微笑。
words.en: A smile is the expression that you have on your face when you are happy or amused, or when you are being friendly. When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.ex: The government introduced new taxation on sugar.
words.ex_cn: 政府对糖征收了新的税。
words.en: Taxation refers to the system by which a government takes money from people and spends it on things such as education, health, and defense.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.ex: He put the child seat in the back of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把儿童安全座椅放在车后座。
words.en: A child seat is a specially designed seat for children to use in vehicles, which provides protection in the event of a crash.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上唱歌。
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.tr: phrase. 高使用率的用户；频繁使用者
words.ex: The app rewards high user with extra features.
words.ex_cn: 该应用为高使用率的用户提供额外功能。
words.en: A person or system that frequently or intensively uses a service or product.

words.tr: phrase. 城堡山；城堡所在的小山或高地
words.ex: They walked up to Castle Hill to see the old castle.
words.ex_cn: 他们走上城堡山去看那座古老的城堡。
words.en: A hill named Castle, often a historic or prominent elevated area.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr: phrase. 山羊皮；用山羊皮制成的材料
words.ex: The shoemaker uses goat skin to make soft shoes.
words.ex_cn: 鞋匠用山羊皮制作柔软的鞋子。
words.en: The hide or skin of a goat, often used for making leather goods, clothing, or musical instruments.

words.tr: n. 短跑运动员；短程竞赛选手；
words.ex: The sprinter ran faster than all others in the race.
words.ex_cn: 这名短跑运动员在比赛中跑得比其他所有人都快。
words.en: A sprinter is an athlete who specializes in short-distance races.

words.ex: The police used fingerprint identification to find the suspect.
words.ex_cn: 警察使用指纹识别来找到嫌疑人。
words.en: Identification is the act of recognizing and naming someone or something, or the process of proving who or what someone or something is.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: The queen wore a golden crown on her head.
words.ex_cn: 女王头上戴着一顶金皇冠。
words.en: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. It can also refer to the top part of something, such as a tooth or a hill, or to the act of making someone a king or queen by placing a crown on their head.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；有联系的； v. 关联；“relate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学相关。
words.en: If two or more things are related, there is a connection between them.

words.tr: phrase. 社会因素；指影响个人或群体行为、态度和发展的社会环境、文化、经济、政治等外部条件
words.ex: Social factors affect how people behave.
words.ex_cn: 社会因素影响人们的行为。
words.en: Social factors are the elements that contribute to the makeup of a society or social environment, influencing behaviors, attitudes, and cultures within a community.

words.tr: adj. 有准备的；准备好的； v. 准备；预备；“prepare”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was prepared for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他为考试做好了准备。
words.en: If you are prepared for something, you are ready for it or have made plans in advance to deal with it.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr:
n. 坟墓；
adj. 严重的；
words.ex: They visited the grave of their grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他们参观了祖父的坟墓。
words.en: A grave is a place where a dead person is buried. When used as an adjective, grave means serious or solemn.

words.ex: He likes maths because it is easy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢数学，因为它很简单。
words.en: the science of numbers, quantities, and shapes and the relationships between them

words.ex: The company is improving its recruitment process.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司正在改进它的招聘流程。
words.en: The process of finding and hiring new employees for a company or organization.

words.ex: The clock struck midnight.
words.ex_cn: 钟敲响了午夜。
words.en: Midnight is twelve o'clock in the middle of the night.

words.tr: phrase. 文化意识；对不同文化的价值观、信仰、习俗和行为方式的理解和认识
words.ex: He shows cultural awareness when he respects different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 当他尊重不同的传统时，他展现了文化意识。
words.en: Cultural awareness refers to the understanding and sensitivity towards the differences and similarities between cultures.

words.tr: phrase. 互动学习；交互式学习
words.ex: The children enjoy interactive learning in class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在课堂上进行互动学习。
words.en: A method of learning that involves direct interaction between the learner and the material being learned, often facilitated by technology or collaborative activities.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.tr: phrase. 开放式问题；无固定答案的问题；允许自由回答的问题
words.ex: The teacher asked open questions to encourage discussion.
words.ex_cn: 老师提出了开放性问题以鼓励讨论。
words.en: Open questions are those that cannot be answered with a simple 'yes' or 'no', but require a more detailed response. They are used to encourage discussion and deeper understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 写作技巧；书写能力
words.ex: He improved his writing skills by practicing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天练习提高了写作技能。
words.en: Writing skills refer to the ability to compose text in a coherent, clear, and effective manner, encompassing grammar, vocabulary, and style.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.ex: The exam was stressful for all students.
words.ex_cn: 这次考试对所有学生来说压力很大。
words.en: If a situation or experience is stressful, it makes you feel worried and tense because of difficulties or problems.

words.ex: The reduction in cost helped the company save money.
words.ex_cn: 成本的减少帮助公司节省了资金。
words.en: The act of making something smaller in size, amount, degree, importance, etc., or the result of this.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.tr: phrase. 导航技能；航行技术；定位与路径规划能力
words.ex: He has good navigational skills to find his way in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 他有很好的导航技能，能在森林中找到路。
words.en: Navigational skills refer to the ability to plan and follow a route from one place to another, especially using maps, compasses, and other tools.

words.ex: Birds begin nesting in spring.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在春天开始筑巢。
words.en: The process by which birds build or occupy nests.

words.tr:
n. 窝；鸟巢；
v. 筑巢；
words.ex: The bird built a nest in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树上筑了一个窝。
words.en: A nest is a structure made by a bird for laying eggs and sheltering its young. It can also refer to a place where insects or other animals lay eggs or raise their young. As a verb, to nest means to build or use a nest.

words.ex: The crocodile is swimming in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼正在河里游泳。
words.en: A crocodile is a large reptile that lives in rivers in the tropical regions of Africa, Asia, America, and Australia. It has a long body, a long tail, and very strong jaws.

words.tr:
n. 收获；收成；
v. 收获；收割；
words.ex: The farmers celebrated the harvest in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 农民们在秋天庆祝收获。
words.en: The harvest is the process of gathering mature crops from the fields. It is a crucial activity in agriculture that marks the end of the growing season.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr: v. 释放；发布；“release”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The zoo released the tiger back into the wild.
words.ex_cn: 动物园把老虎放回了野外。
words.en: If someone or something is released, they are allowed to go or be taken out of a place where they have been kept or trapped.

words.ex: The book costs £35.70.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的价格是35.70英镑。
words.en: A monetary amount of thirty-five pounds and seventy pence in sterling.

words.ex: He completed the registration for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了这门课程的登记。
words.en: Registration is the act of officially recording something, especially in an official list or record.

words.tr: v. 打字；定型；“type”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is typing a letter on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他正在电脑上打一封信。
words.en: The act of writing something using a typewriter or computer keyboard.

words.tr: phrase. 培训费用；训练成本
words.ex: The training costs are high this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的培训费用很高。
words.en: The expenses incurred in providing training to employees or individuals to improve their skills or knowledge.

words.ex: He is a famous poet who writes simple poems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位写简单诗歌的著名诗人。
words.en: A poet is a person who writes poems.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.tr: phrase. 绿色街道（通常指注重环保、绿化良好的街道；也可指代特定地名或项目名称）
words.ex: He lives on Green Street.
words.ex_cn: 他住在格林街。
words.en: A street that is designed to be environmentally friendly, often incorporating vegetation and sustainable drainage systems to manage stormwater and improve air quality.

words.tr: phrase. 西湖（中国杭州著名湖泊及旅游景点）
words.ex: He walks around West Lake every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在西湖边散步。
words.en: A famous freshwater lake located in Hangzhou, China, known for its scenic beauty and cultural heritage.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.tr: phrase. 河滨大道；沿河大街
words.ex: He walks along river avenue every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上沿着河滨大道散步。
words.en: A broad avenue named River, often a main thoroughfare.

words.ex: They parked the caravan by the lake for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们把旅行拖车停在湖边过周末。
words.en: A caravan is a group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, traveling together across a desert in Asia or North Africa.

words.ex: He loves snowboarding in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在山上滑雪板。
words.en: Snowboarding is a winter sport that involves descending a slope that is covered with snow while standing on a snowboard, a flat board with bindings for the rider's feet.

words.tr: n. 呼吸； v. 呼吸；“breathe”的现在分词；
words.ex: Deep breathing helps you relax.
words.ex_cn: 深呼吸有助于你放松。
words.en: The process of taking air into the lungs and expelling it; a sign of life.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.tr:
n. 对照；反差；对立；
v. 对比；和...形成对照；
words.ex: The contrast between light and dark is clear in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片中明暗的对照很明显。
words.en: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.tr:
n. 市场；行情；商场；销路；
v. 营销；
words.ex: The market sells fresh vegetables every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场每天早上卖新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A market is a place where goods are bought and sold, or an area or country where there is a demand for particular goods or services.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: They walked on the golden beach at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他们在日落时走在金色的海滩上。
words.en: A stretch of sand along a shoreline that is golden in color, often associated with beautiful and serene coastal landscapes.

words.ex: He rides a motorbike to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑摩托车上班。
words.en: A motorbike is a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine, which one person rides on.

words.tr: phrase. 东非，指非洲东部地区，包括肯尼亚、坦桑尼亚、乌干达等国家
words.ex: She lives in east africa.
words.ex_cn: 她住在东非。
words.en: East Africa refers to the eastern region of the African continent, which includes countries such as Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, and South Sudan. It is known for its diverse cultures, languages, and significant wildlife.

words.tr: phrase. 树轮；树木年轮（用于判断树木年龄和气候历史）
words.ex: The tree ring shows how old the tree is.
words.ex_cn: 年轮显示了这棵树的年龄。
words.en: A tree ring is a layer of wood in a tree that represents one year of growth. Tree rings are used by scientists to study past climate conditions.

words.tr: n. 图画；绘画；制图； v. 提取；吸引；画；“draw”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child made a drawing of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil, pen, or crayon rather than paint.

words.ex: The festival celebrates ethnic music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日庆祝民族音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Ethnic relates to a group of people who have a common national or cultural tradition.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.tr: abbr. 简历；履历；“curriculum vitae”的缩写
words.ex: He sent his cv to the company.
words.ex_cn: 他把简历发给了公司。
words.en: A document that summarizes a person's education, work experience, and other qualifications for a job.

words.tr: phrase. 亚洲烹饪；亚洲风味的烹饪方式
words.ex: My mom makes delicious asian cooking every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每个周末都做美味的亚洲菜。
words.en: The culinary traditions and practices originating from Asia, characterized by a wide variety of ingredients, flavors, and cooking techniques.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.tr: phrase. 门酒店（通常指位于城门或历史建筑附近的特色酒店）
words.ex: We stayed at the Gate Hotel near the old city gate.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在老城门附近的门酒店。
words.en: A lodging establishment with a gate as a prominent feature or name.

words.tr:
n. 乘船游览；航游；
v. 乘船游览；航游；
words.ex: We went on a cruise around the Mediterranean Sea.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘船游览了地中海。
words.en: To sail about in an area without a precise destination, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.tr: phrase. 山地自行车运动；山地骑行
words.ex: He enjoys mountain biking on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末去山地自行车骑行。
words.en: Mountain biking is the sport of riding bicycles off-road, often over rough terrain, using specially designed mountain bikes.

words.tr: phrase. 车站广场（通常指火车站或地铁站前的公共广场）
words.ex: He waits for the bus at station square.
words.ex_cn: 他在车站广场等公交车。
words.en: A public open area in a town or city, near a railway station, where people can meet or wait.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: Pop music is part of the mainstream.
words.ex_cn: 流行音乐是主流的一部分。
words.en: The ideas, attitudes, or activities that are shared by most people and regarded as normal or conventional.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The feeder gives food to the animals every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上给动物喂食。
words.en: A feeder is someone or something that provides food or supplies to others, or a device that supplies material to a machine.

words.ex: The rescue diver saved the swimmer from the strong current.
words.ex_cn: 救援潜水员从急流中救出了游泳者。
words.en: A rescue diver is a person trained in underwater search and recovery, and in the rescue of individuals in distress in aquatic environments.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: He rode the horse on horseback.
words.ex_cn: 他骑在马背上。
words.en: If you do something on horseback, you do it while riding a horse.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.ex: She wears a swimsuit at the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她在海滩上穿泳衣。
words.en: A swimsuit is a piece of clothing that is worn for swimming, especially by women and girls.

words.tr: phrase. 波浪能；利用海洋波浪运动产生的可再生能源
words.ex: The coast uses wave energy to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 沿海地区利用波浪能发电。
words.en: Wave energy refers to the energy carried by ocean waves, which can be harnessed to generate electricity.

words.tr: phrase. 初级的；入门级的（职位、工作或技能）
words.ex: He got an entry level job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家科技公司找到了一份初级工作。
words.en: At the lowest level of a hierarchy or scale, especially in terms of employment or skill.

words.tr:
n. 冲浪板
v. 以冲浪板滑水
words.ex: He bought a new surfboard last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一块新的冲浪板。
words.en: A surfboard is a long narrow board that is used for surfing.

words.tr: phrase. 音乐厅；歌舞杂耍剧场（19世纪末至20世纪初流行于英国的综艺表演场所）
words.ex: The family went to the music hall to watch the show.
words.ex_cn: 一家人去音乐厅看演出。
words.en: A music hall is a theater or other venue where concerts and other musical performances are held.

words.tr:
n. 铺位；卧铺
v. 提供铺位；睡在铺上
words.ex: He slept in a bunk last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚睡在上铺。
words.en: A bunk is a narrow bed that is fixed to a wall, especially in a ship or caravan.

words.tr:
n. 治疗；疗法；
v. 治愈；治疗；
words.ex: The new medicine is a cure for the disease.
words.ex_cn: 这种新药是这种疾病的治疗方法。
words.en: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear. If a person or animal is cured of an illness or injury, they become well again.

words.ex: The ancient stone has an inscription in Latin.
words.ex_cn: 这块古老的石头上有一段拉丁文碑文。
words.en: An inscription is a piece of writing or a short message that is written or carved on something, especially as a formal or permanent record.

words.tr:
n. 日食；月食；黯然失色
v. 使失色
words.ex: We watched the solar eclipse last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚观看了日食。
words.en: An eclipse occurs when one celestial body moves into the shadow of another, temporarily obscuring it or cutting off its light.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: To turn off a device or light by using a switch.

words.ex: He paid £1100 for the used car.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一千一百英镑买了这辆二手车。
words.en: A monetary amount of one thousand one hundred pounds.

words.ex: He will visit his grandma on 23rd April.
words.ex_cn: 他将在4月23日去看望他的奶奶。
words.en: The twenty-third day of the fourth month in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句

words.tr: phrase. 电话采访；电话面试
words.ex: He did phone interviews for his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他为新工作进行了电话面试。
words.en: A phone interview is a type of job interview conducted over the telephone, often used as an initial screening process.

words.ex: He is good at problem solving in math class.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学课上擅长解决问题。
words.en: The process of finding solutions to difficult or complex issues.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.tr: phrase. 核能；核动力；核电站
words.ex: The country uses nuclear power to make electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家用核能来发电。
words.en: Nuclear power is the use of nuclear reactions that release nuclear energy to generate heat, which most frequently is then used in steam turbines to produce electricity in a nuclear power plant.

words.ex: The occupancy of the hotel is high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天酒店的占用率很高。
words.en: The act of occupying or the state of being occupied, especially the condition of being occupied by tenants or the period during which a property is occupied.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.ex: Curium, or Cm, is a radioactive element used in scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 锔，符号为Cm，是一种用于科学研究的放射性元素。
words.en: A unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre.

words.ex: He stayed home because of illness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: An illness is a particular disease, especially one that is not very serious.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: I live at 788 North Gate.
words.ex_cn: 我住在北门788号。
words.en: The north gate refers to the entrance located on the northern side of a place, such as a city, university, or park.

words.ex: No example sentences
words.ex_cn: 没有例句

words.tr: phrase. 公交车站；公共汽车停靠站
words.ex: The children wait at the bus stops every morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天早上在公交站等车。
words.en: A place where a bus stops to allow passengers to get on and off.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: The comet shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 彗星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A comet is a celestial object consisting of a nucleus of ice and dust and, when near the sun, a 'tail' of gas and dust particles pointing away from the sun.

words.ex: He checked the thermometer to see the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 他看了温度计来查看温度。
words.en: A thermometer is an instrument for measuring and indicating temperature.

words.ex: He sent a telegraph to his family.
words.ex_cn: 他给家人发了一封电报。
words.en: A system for transmitting messages from a distance along a wire, especially one creating signals by making and breaking an electrical connection.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.ex: This festival is a regional tradition.
words.ex_cn: 这个节日是一个地区的传统。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a region.

words.ex: He is a drummer in a rock band.
words.ex_cn: 他是摇滚乐队的一名鼓手。
words.en: A drummer is a person who plays a drum or drums.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: He lives in flat 22a.
words.ex_cn: 他住在22a号公寓。
words.en: A specific apartment or unit within a building, often identified by a number and letter combination.

words.ex: The beach has sandy soil.
words.ex_cn: 这个海滩有含沙的土壤。
words.en: Covered with or consisting mostly of sand.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.ex: He wore a funny costume for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对穿了一套滑稽的服装。
words.en: A costume is a set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or historical period, or a set of clothes worn by an actor for a particular role.

words.ex: The company values flexibility in work hours.
words.ex_cn: 公司重视工作时间的灵活性。
words.en: Flexibility refers to the quality of bending easily without breaking, or the ability to be easily modified to respond to altered circumstances or conditions.

words.ex: She sends emails to helen@greenfield.com every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周一都给 helen@greenfield.com 发邮件。
words.en: An email address belonging to an individual named Helen at the domain greenfield.com.

words.tr: adj. 有苦味的；激烈而不快的；痛苦的；刺痛的；
words.ex: The medicine tastes bitter.
words.ex_cn: 这种药尝起来很苦。
words.en: Having a sharp, pungent taste or smell; not sweet. Feeling or showing anger, hurt, or resentment because of bad experiences or a sense of unjust treatment.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.ex: The children played on the deck of the ship.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在船的甲板上玩耍。
words.en: A deck is a floor-like surface on a ship, or a set of cards used in games. It can also mean to decorate or adorn something.

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: He received compensation for his injured leg.
words.ex_cn: 他因腿部受伤获得了赔偿。
words.en: Compensation is something, typically money, awarded to someone in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.tr:
n. 蜡；
v. 给…上蜡；
words.ex: Bees make wax to build their hives.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂用蜡建造蜂巢。
words.en: Wax is a solid, slightly shiny substance made of fat or oil that is used to make candles, polish, and other products. It can also refer to the process of applying wax to something or the natural substance found in the ear.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.tr: phrase. 旺季；旅游高峰季节
words.ex: Tourists visit the beach in high season.
words.ex_cn: 游客在旺季去海滩。
words.en: The period of the year when a particular place is most popular with tourists and prices are at their highest.

words.ex: The relocation of the factory caused many job changes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂的迁移导致了许多工作变动。
words.en: The act of moving to a new place and establishing one's home or business there.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr: phrase. 海豚岛（常指以海豚为主题的岛屿或旅游景点）
words.ex: We saw a dolphin near dolphin island.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海豚岛附近看到了一只海豚。
words.en: A proper noun, likely the name of an island or a specific location, often used as a proper name for a place or attraction.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He fixed the broken electronics with a small tool.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个小工具修好了坏掉的电子器件。
words.en: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors and microchips, and with the behavior and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor, vacuum, or gas.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: The army trains new soldiers every month.
words.ex_cn: 军队每个月训练新兵。
words.en: An army is a large organized group of people who are armed and trained to fight on land in a war.

words.tr: adj. 明亮的；鲜艳的；聪明的；
words.ex: The room is bright because of the big window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间因为大窗户而很明亮。
words.en: Emitting or reflecting much light; shining.

words.ex: The labour cost rose last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月劳动力成本上涨了。
words.en: The amount of money that a company must spend on wages, salaries, and benefits for its employees.

words.tr: phrase. 警告标志；警示信号
words.ex: The road has warning signs for sharp turns.
words.ex_cn: 这条路上有表示急转弯的警告标志。
words.en: Indicators or signals that suggest a possible danger or problem ahead.

words.tr: phrase. 黑暗区域；阴暗的地方
words.ex: The cat sleeps in the dark area.
words.ex_cn: 猫在黑暗的地方睡觉。
words.en: A dark area is a place or part of something that is not well lit or is shadowed, making it hard to see clearly.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: The city is dealing with population growth.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市正在应对人口增长。
words.en: The increase in the number of people living in a particular area.

words.ex: They went to the concert hall to hear the orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他们去音乐厅听交响乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of concerts and other musical events.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: This food contains a harmless additive for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有用于调味的无害添加物。
words.en: An additive is a substance which is added in small amounts to something else in order to improve it, preserve it, or make it more effective.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.ex: The factory uses a belt to move boxes.
words.ex_cn: 工厂使用传送带来运送箱子。
words.en: A belt is a strip of leather or other material worn around the waist to support clothes or for decoration.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.ex: The honey is sticky.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是黏的。
words.en: Something that is sticky is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.ex: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校乐队里吹喇叭。
words.en: A trumpet is a brass musical instrument with a flared bell and three valves, producing a bright, penetrating tone.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.ex: The dentist placed a dental implant to replace the missing tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医植入了一个牙科植入物来替代缺失的牙齿。
words.en: To implant something means to put it firmly into something else, especially into a person's body.

words.ex: You can find the answer at www.speedtech.com.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在 www.speedtech.com 找到答案。
words.en: A website address for the domain speedtech.com, typically used to access information or services online.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: Last month's rainfall was very low.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的降雨量非常少。
words.en: Rainfall is the amount of rain that falls in a particular area during a particular period.

words.ex: He runs 100 metres in 12 seconds.
words.ex_cn: 他12秒跑完100米。
words.en: A unit of length equal to 100 centimetres.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: He picked up the handset to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起手机给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A handset is a device that is held in the hand, especially one that is used as part of a telephone or radio.

words.tr: 名词短语. 食品分析，指对食品的成分、性质、质量等进行检测和评估的过程
words.ex: The lab does food analysis every week.
words.ex_cn: 实验室每周进行食品分析。
words.en: The process of determining the composition, quality, and safety of food products through various scientific methods.

words.ex: The reliability of this car is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的可靠性很高。
words.en: The quality of being trustworthy or consistent in performance.

words.ex: He ate one third of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了披萨的三分之一。
words.en: One of three equal parts of a divisible whole.

words.tr: phrase. 抽象的概念；指非具体、不可直接感知的思想或观念
words.ex: Children find abstract ideas hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们觉得抽象的概念很难理解。
words.en: Concepts or thoughts that are not physical or tangible, dealing with general principles rather than concrete objects.

words.ex: The darkness made it hard to see the path.
words.ex_cn: 黑暗使我看不清道路。
words.en: The absence of light in a place, making it difficult or impossible to see.

words.tr: phrase. 秘密花园（通常指弗朗西丝·霍奇森·伯内特所著同名经典儿童小说）
words.ex: She reads the secret garden every night.
words.ex_cn: 她每天晚上读《秘密花园》。
words.en: A secret garden refers to a garden that is hidden from view, often used as a private retreat or place of solace.

words.ex: Castles were built in the twelfth century.
words.ex_cn: 城堡在十二世纪被建造。
words.en: The period of one hundred years from 1101 to 1200.

words.ex: The ice age covered big parts of the Earth with ice.
words.ex_cn: 冰河时代使地球的大部分地区被冰覆盖。
words.en: A period in the Earth's history when ice sheets covered large areas of the planet's surface.

words.tr:
n. 低地；
adj. 低地的；
words.ex: The farmers live in the lowland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民们住在河边的低地上。
words.en: Lowland refers to an area of land that is low in relation to the surrounding country.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.tr: n. 切割；剪辑； v. 削减；切；割；“cut”的现在分词； adj. 锐利的；
words.ex: The cutting of the tree took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 砍树的切割只用了五分钟。
words.en: The act or process of cutting something; a piece cut off from something, especially a plant.

words.ex: He has colour blindness and cannot tell red from green.
words.ex_cn: 他有色盲，无法分辨红色和绿色。
words.en: Colour blindness is the inability or decreased ability to see colour, or perceive colour differences, under normal lighting conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 食品处理；食品加工过程中的操作与管理
words.ex: He learned proper food handling at his new job.
words.ex_cn: 他在新工作中学习了正确的食品处理方法。
words.en: The process of preparing, storing, and serving food in a way that reduces the risk of foodborne illness.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.ex: The beetle crawls on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 甲虫在叶子上爬行。
words.en: A beetle is an insect with a hard shell-like back. Beetles are a group of insects which have a large number of species.

words.ex: The submarine sailed quietly under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水艇在海底安静地航行。
words.en: A submarine is a type of ship that can travel underwater. It is used primarily by the military for defense purposes, but some are used for scientific research.

words.tr: n. [英]地铁；管子；管状物；电视机；
words.ex: I take the tube to work every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上乘地铁去上班。
words.en: A tube is a long, hollow cylinder used for conveying or holding liquids or gases.

words.ex: The car's headlight is broken.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的前大灯坏了。
words.en: A headlight is a powerful light at the front of a vehicle, used for illuminating the road ahead.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.ex: He is a novice at playing the guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他是个吉他新手。
words.en: A novice is someone who has just started learning or doing something and does not have much experience.

words.ex: I need an adaptor to charge my phone.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一个适配器来给手机充电。
words.en: An adaptor is a device that enables different pieces of electrical or electronic equipment to be connected, or a person who adapts something, especially a text for a new purpose.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.tr: adj. 无结论的；非决定性的；不确定的
words.ex: The test results were inconclusive.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果没有定论。
words.en: If research or evidence is inconclusive, it has not proved anything.

words.ex: The two teams have unequal chances to win.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍获胜的机会不平等。
words.en: If you say that something is unequal, you mean that it is not equal in size, quantity, quality, or value to something else.

words.ex: He works at a call centre in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦的一家呼叫中心工作。
words.en: A call centre is an office where people work answering or making telephone calls for a particular company.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.tr: phrase. 西欧（指欧洲西部地区，通常包括法国、德国、英国、意大利、西班牙等国家）
words.ex: Many tourists visit western europe for its history and food.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客因为西欧的历史和美食而前往那里。
words.en: Western Europe refers to the western part of Europe, including countries such as France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. It is distinguished by its historical significance, cultural diversity, and economic development.

words.ex: He showed patience while waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他在等公交车时表现出了耐心。
words.en: The ability to stay calm and not get angry, especially when there is a difficulty or you have to wait a long time.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.tr:
n. 连接物；
v. 连接；联系；
words.ex: The chain has a broken link.
words.ex_cn: 这条链子有一个断了的连接物。
words.en: A link between two people, organizations, or places is a connection between them.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: He writes a blog about travel.
words.ex_cn: 他写一个关于旅行的博客。
words.en: A blog is a website containing a writer's or group of writers' own experiences, observations, opinions, etc., and often having images and links to other websites.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: The bee is flying near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂正在花附近飞舞。
words.en: A bee is a flying insect known for its role in pollination and for producing honey and beeswax.

words.ex: The bath is next to the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 浴室在卧室旁边。
words.en: A bath is the process of washing your body, usually by sitting or lying in a container of water.

words.ex: He designs graphics for video games.
words.ex_cn: 他为电子游戏设计绘图。
words.en: Graphics are visual images or designs on some surface, such as a wall, canvas, screen, paper, or stone, to inform, illustrate, or entertain.

words.ex: His assumption was that the train would be on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的假设是火车会准时。
words.en: An assumption is something that you assume to be the case, even without proof.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.tr:
n. 同辈；同等的人；
v. 凝视；
words.ex: He feels comfortable talking to his peers.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得和同辈交谈很自在。
words.en: A peer is someone who is equal to another in abilities, qualifications, age, background, or social status. As a verb, to peer means to look keenly or with difficulty at someone or something.

words.ex: The bank did a credit check before giving the loan.
words.ex_cn: 银行在发放贷款前进行了信用检查。
words.en: A credit check is an examination of an individual's or company's credit history, typically conducted by a financial institution or lender to assess their creditworthiness.

words.tr:
n. 基础；基地；
v. 以…为基础；
words.ex: The base of the building is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的基础非常坚固。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: The sailor heard the shipbell ring at noon.
words.ex_cn: 水手在中午听到了船钟响起。
words.en: A bell on a ship used to signal time or events.

words.ex: I need a photocopy of my passport.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一份护照的影印本。
words.en: A photocopy is a copy of a document made by a photocopier.

words.ex: Good digestion helps your body absorb nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 良好的消化有助于身体吸收营养。
words.en: The process by which food is broken down in the stomach and intestines so that the body can absorb it and use it for energy and nutrients.

words.tr: phrase. 公园大道（纽约曼哈顿一条著名街道，象征高端时尚与奢华生活）
words.ex: He lives on Park Avenue in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约的公园大道。
words.en: A famous street in a major city, often associated with luxury, business, or a specific urban district.

words.ex: He received a confirmation email for his flight.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了航班的确认邮件。
words.en: Confirmation is the act of confirming something or making it more definite.

words.ex: The funder gave money to the school.
words.ex_cn: 资助方给了学校钱。
words.en: A funder is a person or organization that provides money for a particular purpose, especially for a project or for research.

words.ex: This phone is affordable for students.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机对学生来说价格合理。
words.en: If something is affordable, most people have enough money to buy it.

words.tr: phrase. 动作电影；以打斗、追逐、爆炸等激烈场面为主要特征的影片
words.ex: He likes to watch action movie on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看动作片。
words.en: A film genre that features exciting sequences such as fights, chases, and explosions, often with a fast-paced plot.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.tr:
n. 竖琴
v. 反复诉说；唠叨
words.ex: She plays the harp beautifully at concerts.
words.ex_cn: 她在音乐会上优美地演奏竖琴。
words.en: A harp is a large musical instrument consisting of a triangular frame with vertical strings which you pluck with your fingers. If someone harps on about something, they keep talking about it in a way that other people find annoying.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He works at a small law firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小型律师事务所工作。
words.en: A law firm is a business entity formed by one or more lawyers to engage in the practice of law. The primary service rendered by a law firm is to advise clients (individuals or corporations) about their legal rights and responsibilities, and to represent clients in civil or criminal cases, business transactions, and other matters in which legal advice and other assistance are sought.

words.ex: Follow the guideline to complete the form.
words.ex_cn: 按照指导路线完成表格。
words.en: A guideline is a set of rules or instructions that are given by an official organization telling you how to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.tr: n. 马达；发动机；机动车；
words.ex: The car has a strong motor.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强大的马达。
words.en: A motor is a device that changes energy into mechanical motion, especially such a device that provides power for a vehicle or for another device with moving parts.

words.ex: The electric field pushes the charged particle.
words.ex_cn: 电场推动带电粒子。
words.en: An electric field is a region around a charged particle or object within which a force would be exerted on other charged particles or objects.

words.ex: The kettle produces vapour when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生水汽。
words.en: Vapour is a substance in the gas phase at a temperature lower than its critical temperature, which means that the vapour can be condensed to a liquid by increasing its pressure without reducing the temperature.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.ex: The lake is a man-made pond.
words.ex_cn: 这个湖是一个人工池塘。
words.en: Made or caused by human beings rather than occurring naturally.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.tr: phrase. 听力任务；听力练习
words.ex: He completed the listening task before the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 他在铃响前完成了听力任务。
words.en: A task that involves listening, especially as part of learning a language.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: He believes in capitalism and owns a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他相信资本主义，并拥有一家小企业。
words.en: Capitalism is an economic system in which the means of production are privately owned and operated for profit in a competitive market.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: Obesity is a serious health problem in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 肥胖是许多国家的一个严重健康问题。
words.en: Obesity is a medical condition in which excess body fat has accumulated to the extent that it may have a negative effect on health.

words.ex: My grandmother bakes cookies every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我祖母每个星期天都烤饼干。
words.en: Your grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.

words.ex: The wood surface is rough.
words.ex_cn: 木头表面很粗糙。
words.en: If a surface is rough, it is not smooth and has bumps or uneven areas.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.tr: phrase. 口述历史；口述史学；通过录音访谈等方式收集的个人亲历叙述
words.ex: He recorded oral history from his grandfather.
words.ex_cn: 他从祖父那里记录了口述历史。
words.en: Oral history is the collection and study of historical information using tape recordings, videotapes, or transcriptions of planned interviews. These interviews are conducted with people who participated in or observed past events and whose memories and perceptions of these are to be preserved as an aural record for future generations.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.ex: He felt sadness after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到悲伤。
words.en: Sadness is the feeling of being unhappy, especially because something bad has happened.

words.ex: He uses a touch screen to open the app.
words.ex_cn: 他用触摸屏打开应用程序。
words.en: A touch screen is an electronic visual display that the user can control through simple or multi-touch gestures by touching the screen with one or more fingers.

words.tr: n. 护林员；公园看管人；突击队员；
words.ex: The ranger walked through the forest to check for fires.
words.ex_cn: 护林员在森林里巡逻，检查是否有火灾。
words.en: A ranger is someone whose job is to look after a forest or a large park.

words.ex: They found paradise on a small island.
words.ex_cn: 他们在一个小岛上找到了天堂。
words.en: Paradise is a place of ideal beauty or loveliness, or a state of supreme happiness.

words.ex: The ship carries a large cargo of rice.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船运载了大量大米货物。
words.en: Cargo refers to the goods carried by a ship, aircraft, or other large vehicle.

words.tr: phrase. 北欧（指欧洲北部地区，包括斯堪的纳维亚半岛、芬兰、冰岛等国家）
words.ex: He lives in northern europe.
words.ex_cn: 他住在北欧。
words.en: Northern Europe refers to the northern part of Europe, including countries such as Norway, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and Iceland. It is known for its cold climate, beautiful landscapes, and the phenomenon of the Northern Lights.

words.ex: He entered the house through the side door.
words.ex_cn: 他从侧门进了房子。
words.en: A side door is a door at the side of a building, not the main door.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.tr: phrase. 电子邮件营销；通过电子邮件向潜在客户或现有客户发送商业信息的营销方式
words.ex: He uses email marketing to sell products.
words.ex_cn: 他使用电子邮件营销来销售产品。
words.en: Email marketing is a form of direct marketing which uses electronic mail as a means of communicating commercial or fundraising messages to an audience.

words.ex: He drinks iced coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝冰咖啡。
words.en: Coffee that has been chilled and is usually served with ice.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.ex: You can find more information at www.greenride.com.
words.ex_cn: 你可以在 www.greenride.com 上找到更多信息。
words.en: A website address for the domain greenride.com, likely representing a company or service related to transportation or eco-friendly travel.

words.tr: phrase. 海狮（一种生活在海洋中的鳍足类哺乳动物，雄性有明显的鬃毛）
words.ex: The sea lion barks loudly on the rock.
words.ex_cn: 海狮在岩石上大声吠叫。
words.en: A sea lion is a large marine mammal that is related to seals and found chiefly in the Pacific Ocean. Sea lions are characterized by external ear flaps, long foreflippers, the ability to walk on all fours, and short, thick hair.

words.tr: adj. 组合的；结合的； v. 组合；结合；“combine”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The combined effort of both teams won the game.
words.ex_cn: 两个团队的联合努力赢得了比赛。
words.en: Made by joining two or more things or people together.

words.tr: phrase. 青年文化；指年轻人特有的生活方式、价值观、时尚、音乐和行为模式等
words.ex: Youth culture includes music, fashion, and social media.
words.ex_cn: 青年文化包括音乐、时尚和社交媒体。
words.en: Youth culture refers to the way of life, attitudes, and values of young people, often distinct from those of older generations.

words.ex: The quantity of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: A quantity is an amount that you can measure or count.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.tr: phrase. 挖掘技能；挖掘能力
words.ex: He is developing his digging skills in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他正在花园里培养自己的挖掘技能。
words.en: The ability to excavate or remove earth, sand, or other material from the ground effectively.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: The number 45285 appears on the license plate.
words.ex_cn: 数字45285出现在车牌上。

words.ex: The number 45256 appears on the license plate.
words.ex_cn: 数字45256出现在车牌上。

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: He uses computer-aided tools to design bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他使用计算机辅助工具来设计桥梁。
words.en: Using computers to assist in the design, analysis, or manufacture of a product or process.

words.ex: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个圆的直径是10厘米。
words.en: A straight line passing from side to side through the center of a body or figure, especially a circle or sphere.

words.ex: The moon shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 月亮在夜空中明亮地照耀。
words.en: The natural satellite of the earth, visible (chiefly at night) by reflected light from the sun.

words.ex: He listens to a podcast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上听播客。
words.en: A podcast is a digital audio file made available on the internet for downloading to a computer or mobile device, typically available as a series, new installments of which can be received by subscribers automatically.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: He does meditation every morning to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冥想以放松。
words.en: Meditation is the act of remaining in a silent and calm state for a period of time, as part of a religious training, or so that you are more able to deal with the problems of everyday life.

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.ex: He needs time for recovery after the surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他手术后需要时间恢复。
words.en: The process of becoming well again after an illness or injury, or the process of returning to a normal condition after a period of difficulty.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水很浑浊。
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.ex: They used cement to build the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他们用水泥建造了这堵墙。
words.en: Cement is a powdery substance which is mixed with water and used for sticking things together or for making very hard surfaces.

words.tr: phrase. 黑色天鹅绒（一种柔软、有光泽的深黑色织物）；也指一种由黑啤酒和苹果酒混合而成的鸡尾酒
words.ex: She wore a black velvet dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条黑色丝绒连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A rich, deep black fabric, often with a soft, plush texture, used for clothing, upholstery, or decoration.

words.ex: Spring is a beautiful season.
words.ex_cn: 春天是一个美丽的季节。
words.en: A season is one of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn, or winter. It can also refer to a period of the year characterized by particular conditions of weather, temperature, etc., or a period of the year when a particular sport is played.

words.tr:
adj. 富有经验的；加佐料的；风干的
v. 给 ... 调味；适应；风干；“season”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: He is a seasoned cook with many years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有多年经验的熟练厨师。
words.en: If someone is seasoned, they have a lot of experience of something and are therefore able to deal with it in a confident way.

words.tr: n. 处理；加工； v. 处理；加工；“process”的现在分词；
words.ex: The processing of data takes a long time.
words.ex_cn: 数据的处理需要很长时间。
words.en: The act of treating or preparing something by a special method.

words.ex: The mineral soil helps plants grow strong.
words.ex_cn: 矿物质土壤帮助植物茁壮成长。
words.en: Soil that contains a significant amount of mineral matter, as opposed to organic soil which is primarily composed of organic material.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 学校记录；学业成绩档案
words.ex: He checked his school record to see his grades.
words.ex_cn: 他查看了自己的学籍记录来看他的成绩。
words.en: A school record is a collection of documents that detail a student's academic performance, attendance, and other relevant information throughout their time at school.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: The critic praised the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位评论家称赞了这部新电影。
words.en: A critic is a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of books, films, music, etc.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.ex: He had plastic surgery to fix his nose.
words.ex_cn: 他做了整形手术来修复鼻子。
words.en: Plastic surgery is a medical procedure that involves the restoration, reconstruction, or alteration of the human body. It can be divided into two categories: reconstructive surgery and cosmetic surgery.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: His perception of the sound was very sharp.
words.ex_cn: 他对声音的感知非常敏锐。
words.en: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

words.ex: She wore a white pearl necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条白色的珍珠项链。
words.en: A pearl is a hard, rounded object formed within the shell of a pearl oyster or similar mollusk, highly prized as a gemstone.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.tr: phrase. 山地徒步；登山远足；在山间进行的徒步旅行活动
words.ex: They enjoy mountain hiking every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天都喜欢去山里徒步。
words.en: The activity of walking in the mountains for pleasure.

words.ex: The food is in a sealed bag.
words.ex_cn: 食物在一个密封的袋子里。
words.en: A bag that has been closed and sealed, often for security or storage.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr:
v. 适合；相配；
n. 套装；西装；诉讼；
words.ex: This color suits her well.
words.ex_cn: 这个颜色很适合她。
words.en: A suit is a set of clothes made from the same fabric, usually consisting of a jacket and trousers or a skirt. As a verb, to suit means to be appropriate or acceptable for someone or something.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: Children learn to socialise at school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在学校学习进行社交活动。
words.en: To socialise means to participate or to cause someone to participate in social activities; to make someone behave in a way that is acceptable to their society.

words.tr: phrase. 完全会员资格；正式会员身份
words.ex: He has full membership at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有健身房的完整会员资格。
words.en: Full membership refers to the status of being a fully recognized member of a group, organization, or club, with all the rights and privileges that come with it.

words.tr: n. 时间的安排；时间的选择； v. “time”的现在分词；
