words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: This math problem is difficult.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很难。
words.en: Something that is difficult is not easy to do, understand, or deal with.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.tr: phrase. 独立思考；不依赖他人地进行思考
words.ex: He thinks independently when he solves math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时独立思考。
words.en: To think independently means to form your own opinions and make your own decisions without being influenced by others.

words.tr: phrase. 独立思考；自己动脑筋判断
words.ex: Students should learn to think for oneself.
words.ex_cn: 学生应该学会独立思考。
words.en: To form one's own opinions and make decisions independently, without relying on others.

words.tr: phrase. 服从制度；遵守体系；遵循系统规则
words.ex: He must obey the system to stay out of trouble.
words.ex_cn: 他必须遵守制度才能避免麻烦。
words.en: Follow the rules or procedures of an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 照吩咐的去做；听从指示
words.ex: The children do as they are told.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们按要求做事。
words.en: To follow instructions or orders given by someone.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.tr: phrase. 团队合作者；善于与他人协作的人
words.ex: He is a good team player in the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中是个很好的团队合作者。
words.en: A team player is someone who works well as a member of a group, often prioritizing the group's goals over individual ones.

words.ex: He started to learn English early on.
words.ex_cn: 他很早就开始学英语了。
words.en: At an early stage of a period of time or process.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.tr: phrase. 更重要的；更为重要的
words.ex: More important, he finished his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 更重要的是，他按时完成了作业。
words.en: Comparative form of important; used to indicate that something is of greater significance or value than something else.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.tr: phrase. 增加量的；数量增多的
words.ex: The plants grew faster with increased amounts of water.
words.ex_cn: 植物在水量增加的情况下长得更快。
words.en: Greater quantities or numbers than before.

words.ex: He has a high level of English skill.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A high level of something is a large amount of it.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.tr:
n. 踪迹；轨道；小路；跑道；
v. 追踪；跟踪；
words.ex: The dog followed the track of the rabbit.
words.ex_cn: 狗跟着兔子的踪迹。
words.en: A track is a path or route along which something moves or travels. It can also refer to marks left by something that has passed, or the act of following such marks to find someone or something.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: The scientist observe the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 科学家每天早上观察鸟类。
words.en: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: He works for an insurance company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家保险公司工作。
words.en: A company that provides insurance policies to individuals or businesses to protect against financial loss.

words.ex: The insurer paid for the car repair.
words.ex_cn: 保险公司支付了汽车修理费用。
words.en: An insurer is a company or person that provides insurance, which is a financial arrangement that provides compensation for loss, damage, illness, or death in return for payment of a specified premium.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.tr: phrase. 最佳选择；最可能成功的办法
words.ex: Your best bet is to ask the teacher for help.
words.ex_cn: 你最好的选择是向老师求助。
words.en: The most likely thing to be successful or the best choice available.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: He earns 50,000 dollars per year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年赚五万美元。
words.en: Used to indicate that something happens, is done, or is valid for each year.

words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个美丽的女孩。
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.ex: The concert was wonderful.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太精彩了。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The weather is sunny today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气晴朗。
words.en: The condition of the atmosphere at a particular place and time, especially with regard to temperature, precipitation, and wind.

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.ex_cn: 书在哪里？
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.ex: The gym has new exercise equipment.
words.ex_cn: 健身房有新的健身设备。
words.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 合适的服装；适宜的衣着
words.ex: Wear suitable clothing for the weather.
words.ex_cn: 穿上适合天气的衣物。
words.en: Clothing that is appropriate or fitting for a particular situation or purpose.

words.ex: We aim to help students improve their English.
words.ex_cn: 我们旨在帮助学生提高英语水平。
words.en: If you aim to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.tr: n. 美；美的事物；美丽；美人；
words.ex: The beauty of the sunset amazed everyone.
words.ex_cn: 日落的美让所有人都惊叹。
words.en: Beauty is the quality of being pleasing, especially to look at, or someone or something that gives great pleasure, especially when you look at it.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: The rocks show geological evidence of an ancient earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 这些岩石显示了古代地震的地质证据。
words.en: Geological evidence refers to the physical materials and features that provide information about the Earth's history and processes.

words.ex: Scientists find fossils and rocks in the desert.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在沙漠中发现化石和岩石。
words.en: Fossils are the preserved remains or traces of animals, plants, and other organisms from the remote past. Rocks are naturally occurring solid aggregates of one or more minerals or mineraloids.

words.ex: The lake is peaceful in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 清晨的湖面很宁静。
words.en: If a time, place, or situation is peaceful, it is quiet and calm, with no violence or trouble.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: The school prohibits students from using phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If a law or someone in authority prohibits something, they forbid it or make it illegal.

words.ex: The country stopped nuclear testing last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国去年停止了核试验。
words.en: The process of experimenting with or detonating nuclear weapons to assess their effectiveness, safety, and the effects of their detonation.

words.ex: Nuclear explosions can destroy entire cities.
words.ex_cn: 核爆炸可以摧毁整个城市。
words.en: A nuclear explosion is an explosion that occurs as a result of the rapid release of energy from a high-speed nuclear reaction.

words.ex: The building has an impressive size.
words.ex_cn: 这栋建筑规模令人印象深刻。
words.en: Large in a way that inspires admiration.

words.ex: The sheer volume of emails overwhelmed her.
words.ex_cn: 邮件的数量之多让她不堪重负。
words.en: The sheer volume refers to a very large amount or quantity of something, often emphasizing its size or extent.

words.tr: phrase. 观察与调查；观测与研究
words.ex: The scientist made an observation and did an investigation.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家做了观察并进行了调查。
words.en: The act of watching and examining closely.

words.ex: His weakness made him unable to fight back.
words.ex_cn: 他的软弱使他无法反击。
words.en: A weakness is a fault or lack of strength in someone's character or in a system, plan, or design.

words.tr: phrase. 较弱的一方；弱势方
words.ex: He knows his weaker side is public speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他知道自己的弱项是公众演讲。
words.en: The less strong or capable party in a comparison or competition.

words.ex: The coach changed his tactic to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 教练改变了战术以赢得比赛。
words.en: A tactic is a method or plan chosen to bring about a desired future, such as achieving a goal or solving a problem.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.tr:
n. 帮助；援助；
v. 帮助；协助；
words.ex: The charity provided aid to the flood victims.
words.ex_cn: 慈善机构向洪水受害者提供了帮助。
words.en: To aid someone means to help or assist them. Aid can also refer to the help or support given.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.tr:
n. 教练；长途客运汽车；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: The coach taught the team how to win.
words.ex_cn: 教练教球队如何获胜。
words.en: A coach is someone who trains a person or team in a particular sport. It also refers to a large, comfortable bus that carries passengers on long journeys.

words.ex: The trainer helped the athlete improve his speed.
words.ex_cn: 训练者帮助运动员提高了他的速度。
words.en: A trainer is someone who teaches skills to people or animals and prepares them for a job, activity, or sport.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. 小提琴手；小提琴演奏者；
words.ex: The violinist played a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 小提琴手在音乐会上演奏了一首优美的曲子。
words.en: A violinist is a person who plays the violin.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.ex: He loved playing soccer in his early youth.
words.ex_cn: 他在青少年早期喜欢踢足球。
words.en: The earliest stage of childhood.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.ex: He consistently arrives at school on time.
words.ex_cn: 他一贯准时到校。
words.en: In a way that does not vary; in the same way over time.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.tr:
adv. 非常地；
adj. 多；许多；
pron. 许多；
words.ex: She is much happier now.
words.ex_cn: 她现在快乐多了。
words.en: A large amount or to a great degree.

words.tr: adv. 极大地；值得注目地；
words.ex: The new policy significantly improved student performance.
words.ex_cn: 新政策极大地改善了学生的成绩。
words.en: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.ex: The area of the rectangle is 20 square meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形的面积是20平方米。
words.en: An area is a particular part of a place, piece of land, or country.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The central park is in the middle of the city.
words.ex_cn: 中央公园位于城市中心。
words.en: Something that is central is of key or fundamental importance.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生每天读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.tr: adv. 非常地；极其地；极端地；
words.ex: The weather is extremely cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气非常冷。
words.en: To an extreme degree; very.

words.ex: He packed his belongings before moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他在搬去新城市前收拾好了自己的所有物。
words.en: Your belongings are the things that you own, especially things that are small enough to be carried.

words.ex: He carries a small rucksack to school.
words.ex_cn: 他背着一个小背包去学校。
words.en: A small backpack for carrying personal items.

words.ex: This village has a long tradition of making pottery.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有着悠久的制陶传统。
words.en: A long tradition refers to a custom or belief that has existed for a considerable time, often passed down through generations.

words.tr: phrase. 数个世纪以来；长达几个世纪
words.ex: People have used this method for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 几个世纪以来，人们一直使用这种方法。
words.en: For a period of hundreds of years.

words.ex: He played video games all day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在玩电子游戏。
words.en: Throughout the entire day.

words.ex: He worked on the project the whole of the day.
words.ex_cn: 他一整天都在做这个项目。
words.en: The entire duration of a day from morning until night.

words.ex: The old man walks slowly in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在公园里慢慢走路。
words.en: Having lived or existed for a long time; no longer young or new.

words.ex: The castle was built in the twelfth-century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡建于十二世纪。
words.en: Relating to the period from 1101 to 1200 in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.

words.ex: He will take part in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参加学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To be involved in an activity or event.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: He saves money for long-term goals.
words.ex_cn: 他为长期目标存钱。
words.en: Something that is long-term has continued for a long time or will continue for a long time in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 离得很远；还早得很；远未达到
words.ex: The finish line is a long way off.
words.ex_cn: 终点线还很远。
words.en: If something is a long way off, it is not expected to happen until a long time in the future or it is a great distance away.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.ex: He is eating lunch right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在吃午饭。
words.en: At this very moment; immediately.

words.tr: phrase. 不久的将来；近期未来
words.ex: I will buy a new phone in the near future.
words.ex_cn: 我将在不久的将来买一部新手机。
words.en: The near future refers to a time that is not far away from the present, often implying a period within the next few months or years.

words.ex: He will arrive quite soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就到。
words.en: In a short time from now; before long.

words.tr: phrase. 长期未来；远期前景
words.ex: He is saving money for his long-term future.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为自己的长远未来存钱。
words.en: The period of time that is to come, especially the distant future, considered in terms of its potential for development or change.

words.w: a long way in the future
words.tr: phrase. 在遥远的将来；在很久以后
words.uk: ə lɒŋ weɪ ɪn ðə ˈfjuːtʃə(r)
words.us: ə lɔːŋ weɪ ɪn ðə ˈfjutʃər
words.ex: It will be a long way in the future before we live on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 我们在火星上生活还要很久很久以后。
words.en: A phrase used to describe something that will happen after a very long time from now, indicating it is not expected to occur in the near future.

words.tr: adj. 抑郁的； v. 降低；“depress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt depressed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到抑郁。
words.en: If you are depressed, you are sad and feel that you cannot enjoy anything, because your situation is so difficult and unpleasant.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人气馁的；
words.ex: The rainy weather was dispiriting.
words.ex_cn: 阴雨天气令人沮丧。
words.en: Making someone lose their enthusiasm or hope; discouraging.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: She stayed in a luxurious hotel with gold faucets.
words.ex_cn: 她住进了一家有金色水龙头的奢侈酒店。
words.en: Something that is luxurious is very comfortable and expensive, and often involves great pleasure or indulgence.

words.tr: phrase. 高昂的费用；高成本
words.ex: The high costs make it hard to buy the phone.
words.ex_cn: 高昂的成本让买这部手机变得困难。
words.en: High costs refer to the significant amount of money required to produce, maintain, or acquire something, often leading to financial strain or the need for careful budgeting.

words.tr: 短语. 大量的钱；非常多的钱
words.ex: He spent a great deal of money on a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他花了一大笔钱买了一辆新车。
words.en: A large amount of money.

words.ex: The palace had opulent carpets and golden chandeliers.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿里有华丽的地毯和金色的吊灯。
words.en: Having or displaying great wealth or richness.

words.ex: He overlooked the mistake in the report.
words.ex_cn: 他忽略了报告中的错误。
words.en: If you overlook a fact or problem, you do not notice it, or do not realize how important it is.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The children are playing in their natural surroundings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在他们的自然环境中玩耍。
words.en: The things and conditions around a person, place, or thing.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉而亲切的；令人感到温馨和欢迎的
words.ex: The small café has a familiar and inviting atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 这家小咖啡馆有一种熟悉而温馨的氛围。
words.en: Comfortable and welcoming in nature.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: The guest arrived at the party early.
words.ex_cn: 客人早早到了派对。
words.en: A guest is someone who is visiting a place or attending an event by invitation, without having a permanent role there.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的；多种多样的
words.ex: There is a wide variety of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: A wide variety of means there is a large range of different types of something.

words.tr: 短语. 各种各样的；整个范围的；大量的（用于描述一系列事物）
words.ex: He has a whole range of hobbies, like drawing, swimming, and reading.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如画画、游泳和阅读。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a wide variety or a large number of different things or types.

words.tr: 短语动词. 没有效果；不起作用；不产生影响
words.ex: The rain has no effect on my plan.
words.ex_cn: 下雨对我的计划没有影响。
words.en: To fail to produce any change or result.

words.ex: It does not matter if you are late.
words.ex_cn: 你迟到没关系。
words.en: Are not important or significant.

words.ex: She wears stylish clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着时髦的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is stylish is fashionable and attractive.

words.ex: The car has a sleek design.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有着流畅的外形。
words.en: Sleek describes something that is smooth, glossy, and streamlined, often implying a sense of elegance and efficiency.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.tr: phrase. 平凡的日常；平淡无奇的常规生活
words.ex: He lives an ordinary routine life with work and sleep every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天过着平凡的日常生活，工作和睡觉。
words.en: A life characterized by regular, everyday activities and habits.

words.ex: Technology changes our everyday lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技改变着我们的日常生活。
words.en: The routine or typical activities, experiences, and events that occur in the day-to-day existence of individuals or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 照料；关怀；喜欢；想要
words.ex: She cares for her sick mother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她生病的母亲。
words.en: To like or love someone or something; to look after someone or something.

words.ex: She looks after her little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天照顾她的弟弟。
words.en: To take care of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 所有方面；全部要素
words.ex: He checked all aspects of the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他检查了计划的所有方面。
words.en: Every part or area of a subject, situation, or activity.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr: n. 化妆品；美容品；“cosmetic”的复数；
words.ex: She buys cosmetics at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 她在药店买化妆品。
words.en: Substances or treatments used to enhance or alter the appearance of the face or body.

words.ex: He uses shampoo and soap every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都用洗发水和香皂。
words.en: Products used for washing hair and cleaning the body.

words.ex: He raised an objection to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定提出了反对。
words.en: An objection is an expression or feeling of disapproval or opposition; a reason for disagreeing.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 徒步旅行；步行观光
words.ex: We went on a walking tour of the old city.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了老城区的步行游览。
words.en: A walking tour is a guided or self-guided tour of a city or area, where participants walk to see the sights and learn about the history and culture.

words.ex: These are the most comfortable shoes I have ever worn.
words.ex_cn: 这些是我穿过的最舒服的鞋子。
words.en: Footwear that provides the highest level of comfort for the wearer.

words.tr:
adj. 原来的；有创造性的；原版的；新颖的；
n. 原件；原稿；
words.ex: This is the original book I bought last year.
words.ex_cn: 这是我去年买的那本原版书。
words.en: An original piece of writing or music was written recently and has not been published or performed before.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: The old industrial buildings are now empty.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧的工业建筑现在空着。
words.en: Buildings used for industrial purposes, such as manufacturing, production, or storage.

words.ex: The boxes are stored in the warehouse.
words.ex_cn: 这些箱子存放在仓库里。
words.en: A warehouse is a large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored before their export or distribution for sale.

words.tr: phrase. 当地居民；本地住户
words.ex: Local residents walk their dogs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 当地居民每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: People who live in a particular area or community.

words.ex: The local community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 当地社区一起清理了公园。
words.en: A local community is a group of people living in the same place or having a particular characteristic in common, often sharing interests and goals.

words.tr: phrase. 公寓楼；住宅大楼（指多户家庭居住的多层建筑）
words.ex: Many people live in apartment blocks in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在城市里的公寓楼里居住。
words.en: A building containing several apartments, especially in a city.

words.tr: phrase. 高层住宅；高层住房
words.ex: Many families live in high-rise housing in the city.
words.ex_cn: 许多家庭住在城市里的高层住宅中。
words.en: High-rise housing refers to residential buildings that are significantly taller than the surrounding structures, typically found in urban areas to accommodate a large number of people in a limited space.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr: phrase. 工业生产；工业产量
words.ex: The factory increased its industrial production last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月提高了工业产量。
words.en: Industrial production refers to the output of industrial establishments, covering sectors such as manufacturing, mining, and utilities.

words.tr: phrase. 大规模地；大范围地
words.ex: They built houses on a large scale after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，他们大规模地建造房屋。
words.en: Involving a large number of people or things, or covering a large area.

words.ex: The number of people using the internet has increased dramatically.
words.ex_cn: 使用互联网的人数急剧增加。
words.en: to become much larger in amount or number

words.ex: The box contains five apples.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子包含五个苹果。
words.en: If something such as a box, bag, room, or place contains things, those things are inside it.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我这个消息。
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.tr:
n. 信号；
v. 用信号通知；
words.ex: The traffic light is a signal to stop.
words.ex_cn: 交通灯是一个停止的信号。
words.en: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.tr: v. 警告；告诫；提醒注意；
words.ex: The teacher warned the students not to be late.
words.ex_cn: 老师警告学生不要迟到。
words.en: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我看到树上有一只鸟。
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.ex_cn: 猫在沙发后面。
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: The cat is sitting at the back of the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在房间的后面。
words.en: At the back refers to a position behind something or someone.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.tr: n. 活页练习题；工作记录；工作表
words.ex: The teacher gave the students a worksheet for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师给学生们发了一份练习表作为家庭作业。
words.en: A worksheet is a piece of paper on which problems or tasks are set for students or workers to solve or complete.

words.tr: phrase. 带问答测验的讲义
words.ex: The teacher gave handouts with questions and quizzes for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师发了带有问题和小测验的讲义作为家庭作业。
words.en: Distributed materials containing questions and short tests for assessment.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: He took a photo with his camera.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的摄像机拍了一张照片。
words.en: A camera is a piece of equipment that is used for taking photographs, making films, or producing television pictures.

words.ex: He takes photographs of birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上拍鸟的照片。
words.en: To capture images with a camera.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.tr: phrase. 视觉记录；影像资料
words.ex: He keeps visual records of his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他保存旅行的视觉记录。
words.en: Visual records refer to any form of documentation that captures images or visual information, such as photographs, videos, or digital images, used for historical, educational, or research purposes.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: To consume food, typically as a regular part of one's diet.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.tr:
n. 饮料；酒；
v. 喝；喝酒；
words.ex: I bought a cold drink at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了一瓶冷饮。
words.en: To take liquid into the mouth and swallow it; a liquid that can be swallowed as refreshment or nourishment.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.tr: n. 筛查； v. “screen”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clinic offers free cancer screening for adults.
words.ex_cn: 该诊所为成年人提供免费的癌症筛查。
words.en: The process of examining or testing people or things to find out if they are suitable for a particular purpose, especially to find out if they have a particular disease.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周从银行提取钱。
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.ex_cn: 墙上的油漆正在剥落。
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算机做作业。
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.tr: abbr. 光盘只读存储器；光盘驱动器；“compact disc read-only memory”的缩写
words.ex: He uses a cd-rom to play games.
words.ex_cn: 他用光盘来玩游戏。
words.en: A CD-ROM is a CD on which a very large amount of information can be stored to be read by a computer. CD-ROM is an abbreviation for 'compact disc read-only memory'.

words.tr: vt.对···重新进行排序，把·····重新排序
words.ex: He must reorder the books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他必须重新整理书架上的书。
words.en: to arrange something in a different order; to order something again

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.ex: This math problem is easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很容易。
words.en: If a job or action is easy, you can do it without difficulty because it is not complicated and causes no problems.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学题很难。
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr:
n. 研究；探索；调查；
v. 研究；调查；探讨；
words.ex: He did research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了关于气候变化的研究。
words.en: Research is work that involves studying something and trying to discover facts about it.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr:
adv. 在网上地；在线地；
adj. 联机的；在线的；
words.ex: He works online from home.
words.ex_cn: 他在家网上工作。
words.en: Connected to or available through a computer network, especially the Internet.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: He goes to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天去上学。
words.en: To move or travel from one place to another.

words.tr: adj. 感兴趣的； v. “interest”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is interested in reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他对读书感兴趣。
words.en: If you are interested in something, you want to give your attention to it and learn more about it.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: The map shows many geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图展示了山脉和河流等许多地理特征。
words.en: Geographical features refer to the natural and artificial physical characteristics of a place or region, including its landforms, bodies of water, climate, soils, natural vegetation, and animal life.

words.ex: The wind erodes sandstone plateaux and cliffs slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风慢慢侵蚀砂岩高原和悬崖。
words.en: Geological formations consisting of hard, layered rock with steep faces.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.ex: The school organized a fun activity for the students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生们组织了一场有趣的活动。
words.en: An activity is something that you spend time doing.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上做作业。
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物长在窗边。
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: The company will hire a new manager next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司下周将雇用一位新经理。
words.en: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

words.ex: They explore the forest to find hidden caves.
words.ex_cn: 他们探索森林以寻找隐藏的洞穴。
words.en: To explore means to travel over or through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it or to search for something valuable.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一本书。
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: He studies dynamics to understand how forces move objects.
words.ex_cn: 他学习动态学以理解力如何使物体运动。
words.en: Dynamics is the branch of mechanics that deals with the motion of bodies under the action of forces, considering the mass and velocity of the bodies.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.w: the ways in which we choose to live
words.tr: phrase. 我们选择的生活方式
words.uk: ðə weɪz ɪn wɪtʃ wiː tʃuːz tə lɪv
words.us: ðə weɪz ɪn wɪtʃ wi tʃuz tə lɪv
words.ex: The ways in which we choose to live affect our health.
words.ex_cn: 我们选择的生活方式影响我们的健康。
words.en: The personal choices and methods that define an individual's lifestyle.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.ex: He loves cartography and draws maps for fun.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢制图，闲暇时画地图。
words.en: Cartography is the science or practice of drawing maps.

words.ex: He loves map-making in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间制作地图。
words.en: The process or skill of making maps.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.tr: adj. 有关联的；相关的；联合的； v. 联想；联合；“associate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are associated with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是有关联的。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected in some way.

words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The government does a census every ten years.
words.ex_cn: 政府每十年进行一次人口普查。
words.en: A census is an official count or survey of a population, typically recording various details of individuals.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with the help of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的帮助下解决了这道数学题。
words.en: With the assistance or support of someone or something.

words.ex: The teacher collected data from the students' tests.
words.ex_cn: 老师收集了学生测试的数据。
words.en: Data is information, especially facts or numbers, collected to be examined and considered and used to help decision-making, or information in an electronic form that can be stored and used by a computer.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.tr: adj. 二维的；平面的；表面的；无深度的
words.ex: The drawing is two-dimensional.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是二维的。
words.en: Something that is two-dimensional has only two dimensions, usually length and width, and does not have depth.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.tr:
adj. 一些；某些；
pron. 有些；若干；
words.ex: I need some water.
words.ex_cn: 我需要一些水。
words.en: used to refer to an unspecified amount or number of something

words.tr: 短语. 某种程度上的；一定程度的
words.ex: He has a certain degree of confidence in his skills.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的技能有一定的信心。
words.en: To a specific but not necessarily high or extreme extent.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树长在房子旁边。
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.tr: adj. 有病的；患病的；病态的；
words.ex: The diseased tree was removed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 那棵有病的树被从花园里移除了。
words.en: Affected with or suffering from a disease.

words.ex: The density of water is 1 gram per cubic centimeter.
words.ex_cn: 水的密度是每立方厘米1克。
words.en: Density is a measure of how much mass is contained in a given unit volume of a substance.

words.ex: How much is this apple?
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多少钱？
words.en: used to ask about the amount or degree of something

words.ex: The ocean floor is very deep and dark.
words.ex_cn: 海底非常深且黑暗。
words.en: The bottom of the sea, especially the part between the shore and the abyssal zone.

words.ex: The fish swim near the sea bed.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在海床上游动。
words.en: The bottom of a sea or ocean.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: The origin of this tradition is unknown.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统的起源不明。
words.en: The origin of something is the point or place where it begins, or the cause from which it arises.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校走回家。
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.ex: The arrival of the train was delayed by 20 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 火车的到达晚了20分钟。
words.en: The act of coming to a place or the moment when something or someone arrives.

words.ex: He arrives at the station at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他早上8点到达车站。
words.en: To reach a place, especially at the end of a journey.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.ex: His purpose is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的目的是帮助别人。
words.en: The reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists.

words.ex: The committee's remit includes education and health.
words.ex_cn: 该委员会的职权范围包括教育和健康。
words.en: To remit means to send money as payment for something, or to refer a matter to someone else for consideration or decision.

words.ex: He values education very much.
words.ex_cn: 他非常重视教育。
words.en: Education is the process of teaching and learning, especially in a school or college, or the knowledge that you get from this.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图找路。
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 对……来说是越界或不允许的；超出某人权限或范围的
words.ex_cn: 真相对他来说是不可触及的。
words.en: To be prohibited or not allowed to enter a particular area or engage in a specific activity.

words.tr: adj. 以实验为基础的；实验性的；
words.ex: The scientist used an experimental method to test the theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用了一种以实验为基础的方法来检验这个理论。
words.en: Relating to or based on experiment.

words.tr:
n. 实验；试验；
v. 做试验；进行实验；
words.ex: The boy did a science experiment in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩在课堂上做了一个科学实验。
words.en: An experiment is a scientific procedure undertaken to make a discovery, test a hypothesis, or demonstrate a known fact.

words.ex: How do you make coffee?
words.ex_cn: 你如何煮咖啡？
words.en: In what way or manner; by what means.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 步行； v. 步行；行走；“walk”的现在分词； adj. 步行的；
words.ex: Walking is good for your health.
words.ex_cn: 步行对健康有益。
words.en: Walking is the activity of going for a walk, especially for pleasure or exercise.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.ex: The hen is laying eggs in the coop.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡正在鸡舍里下蛋。
words.en: A hen is a female chicken, especially one that is kept for its eggs.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.tr:
v. 保存；保护；保持；
n. （某群体）专有的活动；
words.ex: She preserves fresh fruit by making jam.
words.ex_cn: 她通过做果酱来保存新鲜水果。
words.en: To preserve something means to maintain it in its original or existing state.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.ex: Rare birds can be seen in this forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种森林里可以看到稀有的鸟类。
words.en: Something that is rare is not common and is therefore interesting or valuable.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.tr:
n. 辩论；讨论；
v. 辩论；讨论；
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

words.tr: n. （同一事物）不同种类；多样性；（动植物的）品种；变化；
words.ex: The store sells a variety of apples.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的苹果。
words.en: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟飞过树。
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: The goose is swimming in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这只鹅正在湖里游泳。
words.en: A goose is a large bird that has a long neck and webbed feet. Geese are often kept for their meat, feathers, or as guard animals.

words.tr: phrase. 当前；现在；目前的时刻
words.ex: He is working hard in the present time.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在努力工作。
words.en: The current period or moment in time.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.tr: n. 螨；小虫；极小量；小家伙
words.ex: A mite is very small and lives on animals.
words.ex_cn: 螨虫非常小，生活在动物身上。
words.en: A mite is a very small creature which is related to spiders. There are many different kinds of mites, some of which can cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr: v. 大批出没于；成群滋扰；遍布于；寄生
words.ex: The bugs infest the old house.
words.ex_cn: 这些虫子侵袭了这栋老房子。
words.en: If creatures such as insects or rats infest a place, they are present in large numbers and usually cause damage or disease.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: We eat homegrown vegetables from our garden.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃来自自家菜园的本土蔬菜。
words.en: Homegrown refers to something that is grown or produced in one's own country or locality, rather than being imported.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.ex: The forest has rich flora with many wild flowers.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有丰富的植物，有许多野花。
words.en: The plants of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: Lying has serious consequences.
words.ex_cn: 撒谎会有严重的后果。
words.en: A consequence is a result or effect of an action or condition.

words.tr: phrase. 影响经济；对经济产生作用或改变
words.ex: The storm affected the economy badly.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴严重影响了经济。
words.en: To have an influence on the financial and commercial activities of a region.

words.tr: phrase. 损失大量金钱；赔很多钱
words.ex: He loses a lot of money on gambling.
words.ex_cn: 他因赌博输掉了很多钱。
words.en: To suffer a significant financial loss.

words.ex: Farmers work hard in agriculture.
words.ex_cn: 农民在农业中辛勤工作。
words.en: The science or practice of farming, including cultivation of the soil for the growing of crops and the rearing of animals to provide food, wool, and other products.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: The student reads a book every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个学生每天读书。
words.en: A student is a person who is studying at a university or college.

words.tr:
n. 研究生；
adj. 大学毕业后的；
words.ex: He is a postgraduate at Beijing University.
words.ex_cn: 他是北京大学的一名研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate is a student who continues studying after obtaining a first degree, usually in order to obtain a higher qualification.

words.ex: He travels to other countries every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去其他国家旅行。
words.en: Nations other than one's own.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 教室里有38个人。
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: The population of this city is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的人口正在快速增长。
words.en: The number of people living in a particular area, city, or country; the total number of people who live in a place.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He is in employment at a local store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地商店工作。
words.en: If someone is in employment, they have a job and are working for an employer.

words.tr: phrase. 大范围的；范围广泛的
words.ex: The store has a wide range of toys for children.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店有各种各样的儿童玩具。
words.en: A wide range of means there is a large variety or a great number of different things within a particular category.

words.tr:
n. 限制；
v. 限制；
words.ex: The teacher set a limit on homework time.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业时间设定了限制。
words.en: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.tr: phrase. 英国（United Kingdom 的缩写）
words.ex: The UK has many old castles.
words.ex_cn: 英国有很多古老的城堡。
words.en: The United Kingdom, a country in northwestern Europe, consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗服务；医疗保健服务
words.ex: The village has good medical services.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有良好的医疗服务。
words.en: Medical services refer to the provision of medical care to individuals or communities by medical professionals.

words.ex: He needs better medical care after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后需要更好的医疗照顾。
words.en: The provision of what is necessary for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease and the maintenance of health.

words.tr: phrase. 新闻界；报刊；记者群体
words.ex: The press reported the news yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 媒体昨天报道了这则新闻。
words.en: The press refers to news reporters and photographers collectively, and the organizations they work for, especially newspapers and magazines, or the news coverage they provide.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr: phrase. 媒体；新闻界；大众传播媒介
words.ex: The media reports news every day.
words.ex_cn: 媒体每天报道新闻。
words.en: The main means of mass communication (broadcasting, publishing, and the Internet), regarded collectively.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: Don't worry about the test. You will do well.
words.ex_cn: 别担心考试，你会考好的。
words.en: To feel anxious or concerned about something or someone.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: He was unsuccessful in finding a job.
words.ex_cn: 他找工作没有成功。
words.en: Not achieving the desired results; not successful.

words.ex: We need further research to understand this problem.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要进一步的研究来理解这个问题。
words.en: Additional studies or investigations carried out to explore a subject in more depth or to verify previous findings.

words.tr: phrase. 更具深远影响的研究；范围更广、意义更深远的科研
words.ex: This study leads to more far-reaching research on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究引发了关于气候变化更具深远影响的研究。
words.en: Research that has a broad and significant impact or consequence.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: His unwillingness to help made everyone sad.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意帮忙，让每个人都很难过。
words.en: The lack of desire or enthusiasm to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 停止参与；不再参加
words.ex: He decided to stop participating in the game.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不再参加比赛。
words.en: To cease taking part in an activity or event.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr: phrase. 一年级学生；大一新生
words.ex: He is a first-year student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一年级学生。
words.en: A first-year student is someone who is in their first year of study at a college or university.

words.ex: The doctor must keep patient information confidentiality.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须保持病人的信息机密性。
words.en: The state of keeping or being kept secret or private.

words.tr: adj. 可追踪的；可追溯的；
words.ex: The package is traceable using the tracking number.
words.ex_cn: 使用跟踪号码可以追踪这个包裹。
words.en: If something is traceable, it can be tracked or followed back to its source or origin.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
